record.note: Prompts and model reasoning are not stored, so they are not here. Each call lists the tokens the model spent reasoning.

attempt.objective: A full game with no human player, played to Fall 1999 or a solo win.

messages.body: I propose a peaceful border this year: please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and I’ll keep A Vienna out of Piedmont. Any plans for the Balkans or our shared border?

Let’s avoid a Balkan clash: I intend to seek Serbia and Greece, while you can take Bulgaria. I’d welcome a non-aggression understanding around the Balkans; what are your plans for F Ankara and A Constantinople?
I propose Galicia as a demilitarized zone this year: I’ll keep A Vienna out, and ask that A Warsaw stay out as well. What are your intentions for Romania and the Balkans?

England here. I'm happy to stay out of the Channel and North Sea fights with you. Could you keep Brest out of the Mid-Atlantic toward me, and let's both focus on Germany and Belgium rather than each other this spring?

England to Germany: I'd prefer no conflict in the North Sea. If you keep Kiel focused on Denmark or Holland instead of moving toward Norway, I'll keep my fleets out of the Helgoland approaches and send Edinburgh north rather than toward you.

I propose we keep the Channel clear this spring: I’ll move F Brest to Mid-Atlantic Ocean, and ask that F London stay out of the Channel. Let’s avoid a needless early fight and discuss Belgium access before autumn.
I propose a Burgundy DMZ this spring: I’ll keep A Paris out of Burgundy if you keep A Munich out. I’m open to coordinating over Belgium; what are your intentions for it?

I intend to focus west and would prefer a quiet border with Italy. Can we agree not to move against each other this spring, and coordinate so neither of us needlessly blocks the other’s access to neutral centers?

Germany here. I have no interest in attacking you this year. I propose we both stay out of each other's way: I take Holland and Belgium, you take Sweden and Norway. Can you confirm you won't move against Berlin or Kiel?

Germany to France: I'm willing to leave Belgium alone if you keep your armies away from Munich and Ruhr. Would you consider a non-aggression pact in the west while we both look east or south? What are your plans for Burgundy?
Germany to Austria: Let's keep Munich and Tyrolia calm this spring. I'd rather not see Russia or Italy pressure you on two fronts. Are you planning to move against Italy or Russia this year?
I propose a calm opening between us: I won't move A Venice to Tyrolia or Trieste this spring if you keep out of Venice. What are your plans for the Balkans?
Let's avoid an unnecessary western clash. I propose you keep out of Piedmont and I keep out of the Gulf of Lyon this spring. Are you planning to contest the western Mediterranean?
What are your plans for Greece and the Balkans? I'd like to avoid a conflict between us while I secure Tunis; let me know if you have a specific proposal.

Russia here. Let's keep the Black Sea quiet this year. I won't move F SEV into Rumania or bounce your fleets. Could you leave SEV alone and focus your army on Serbia or Bulgaria instead? I'd appreciate knowing your plans for ANK and CON.

Russia to Austria: I'm happy to see you take Serbia and Rumania rather than fighting me in Galicia. In return, please keep A WAR's neighbors calm and don't move on Ukraine. Are you planning to go after Italy or Turkey this year?

Russia to Germany: With Warsaw and Moscow both mine, I'd like to keep Prussia and Sweden for the moment. Would you consider moving toward Holland or Denmark rather than Russia? Let me know what A BER and F KIE intend this spring.
I propose a clear understanding: Turkey takes Bulgaria, Russia takes Rumania, and neither of us moves into the Black Sea this year. What are your intentions for F Sevastopol and the Balkans?

I intend to focus on Bulgaria and would like a quiet Balkan opening. Could we agree that Turkey takes Bulgaria while Austria pursues Serbia, with neither of us moving against the other's home centers?
I’d welcome a stable opening between us. I have no plans to move against Italy; would you keep F Naples out of the eastern Mediterranean this spring? Let me know what you’re considering.

I’m not planning an attack on Germany. My priority is securing Balkan centers and avoiding a two-front conflict; I’ll keep A Vienna out of Tyrolia this spring. I’m seeking a calm border with Italy, while watching developments to the east.

I intend to take Serbia and Greece, and will not move A Vienna to Galicia or A Budapest to Ukraine. I’m not planning to attack Russia; let’s keep Galicia clear. Please avoid an advance into Galicia, and clarify whether F Sevastopol is going to Romania.

Agreed: I’ll keep A Vienna out of Piedmont and won’t move against Venice. I plan to pursue Serbia and Greece, coordinating a quiet Balkan opening with Turkey. Please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste, as proposed.

Agreed: you take Bulgaria and I’ll pursue Serbia and Greece. I’ll make no move against your home centers this spring. I suggest F Ankara support A Constantinople to Bulgaria, while A Smyrna moves to Constantinople, if that suits your plans.

England here. Agreed on keeping the Channel calm this spring. F London will stay out of the Channel and move north-to-Norway or hold, not toward Brest. Please keep your fleet out of the North Sea and Irish waters. Let's discuss Belgium before autumn, but I'm not promising my fleets to any particular line yet.

I’ll keep F Brest out of the Channel, and F London out of it would be welcome. I still intend F Brest–Mid-Atlantic, but that is not a move against England; I won’t use it to threaten your centers this spring. Belgium remains open for discussion before autumn.

Agreed to the Burgundy DMZ: A Paris will stay out of Burgundy, and I ask A Munich to do the same. I’m not committing to leave Belgium alone; let’s coordinate there before autumn and avoid a clash between us.

Agreed: I’ll keep out of Piedmont, and ask F Naples to stay out of the Gulf of Lyon. F Brest is headed to the Mid-Atlantic, not to contest your western Mediterranean interests. Let’s keep the border quiet this spring.

Germany to England: Agreed, I have no wish for conflict in the North Sea. Kiel will head toward Denmark and Holland, not Norway. Please keep your fleets away from Helgoland and Kiel's approaches, and we can revisit the North Sea in the autumn.

Germany to Russia: I can't confirm anything about Berlin or Kiel yet, but I have no plan to attack you this spring. I'm looking west toward Holland and Belgium. If you keep your armies out of Prussia and away from Berlin, we can both benefit. Let's keep talking.

Germany to France: A Burgundy DMZ works for me. I will keep A Munich out of Burgundy and Ruhr if you keep A Paris out of Burgundy and Belgium is left open to negotiation. I'd prefer a clear non-aggression pact in the west while we both look east and south.

Agreed: I’ll keep out of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon this spring, and I’m not contesting the western Mediterranean. I plan to secure Tunis; please let me know if you have concerns about coordinating over Spain.

Agreed: A Venice will stay out of Tyrolia and Trieste, and I’ll keep it out of Venice. I have no plans to move against you this spring; my priority is Tunis. What are your Balkan plans, especially regarding Greece?

Agreed: F Naples will stay out of the eastern Mediterranean this spring. I intend to move it to Tunis and would prefer a calm border. Are you planning to take Greece, or do you expect to move elsewhere in the Balkans?

Russia here. Sweden and Norway are my interest, and I'll keep A WAR and A MOS away from Berlin and Kiel. Holland and Belgium are yours to pursue, but I'd like to see F KIE and A BER stay out of Prussia this spring. Let's both watch Denmark.

Russia here. Galicia as a demilitarized zone works for me this spring. I'll keep A WAR out of Galicia and Ukraine's neighbors calm. Rumania is open for you, but I plan to move on Sweden and Norway, so I'd rather we not clash there. Italy and Turkey are your business.

Russia here. Agreed: F SEV stays out of Rumania and the Black Sea this year, and I'll expect the same from ANK and CON. Bulgaria is yours. Keep your fleets out of Sevastopol and I'll do the same. Let's talk again next season.

Agreed: I’ll take Bulgaria with A CON and keep F ANK out of the Black Sea. I ask that F SEV stay out of the Black Sea and that Russia pursue Rumania. A SMY will head toward Greece, so please keep your Balkan plans clear of it.

Agreed on a quiet opening: A CON to Bulgaria, and I’ll keep F ANK out of the Adriatic and Black Sea. I’m considering A SMY toward Greece; are you still aiming for Greece as well as Serbia? Let’s avoid a clash and coordinate over Greece.

I plan to take Bulgaria with A CON and may send A SMY toward Greece. I have no plans against Italy or the Ionian Sea this spring. Please keep F NAP out of the eastern Mediterranean, including the Ionian, and we can avoid a Balkan clash.

I plan F Albania to Greece this fall, with A Serbia supporting. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Greece and hold Bulgaria; I’ll make no move against your home centers. That gives us both a secure Balkan center.

Let’s keep our border peaceful this fall: please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste, and I’ll avoid moving against your centers. My F Albania is pursuing Greece; are you planning any move toward the Balkans?
I’m pursuing Greece with F Albania and will keep Galicia clear. Please keep F Romania out of Serbia and Bulgaria this fall; I won’t contest your position in Romania.

England here. Fall 1901: I'm moving F Nth and F Nwg north-east, so the Channel and North Sea stay quiet from my side. Please confirm F Mao stays off the Irish Sea and English Channel approaches, and that Belgium is not a French move for now. If you're going into Belgium, let's talk about what you'd want in return.
I intend A Pic-Bel and F MAO-Por this autumn. Please keep F NTH out of Belgium; I’ll keep F MAO out of the Channel and North Sea. Norway is open for you.
I propose France take Belgium with A Pic-Bel, while Germany takes Holland with F Den-Hol. Please keep your units out of Belgium and I’ll honor the Burgundy DMZ; we can avoid a western clash.
I’ll keep out of Piedmont and have no plans to contest the western Mediterranean. I intend F MAO-Por and A Pic-Bel this autumn; please keep your units clear of Spain and the Gulf of Lyon.

Germany to France: Burgundy DMZ still stands. Belgium is the question. I plan to move on Holland and possibly Belgium this autumn. If you take Belgium with A Picardy or F English Channel, we have a conflict. Would you accept Belgium to me in exchange for a clean western border and support against Italy later?

Germany to England: Kiel is heading to Denmark and Holland, not Norway, as agreed. I'm watching your F Norwegian Sea and F North Sea. Are you planning to take Norway with F NTH or F NWG this autumn? If so, let's keep Skagerrak and Helgoland clear of each other.

Germany to Russia: F Denmark stays put unless you move against me. I won't attack Berlin or Kiel. Please confirm your fleet F Finland and A Moscow will not enter Prussia or Denmark this autumn. Keeping Sweden and Norway for you is fine with me.

I’m retaking my vacant home centers this fall: A Tuscany to Venice, A Apulia to Rome, and F Tyrrhenian Sea to Tunis. I’ll honor our agreement and keep Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste. Please keep your units clear of Venice.

I’ll send F Tyrrhenian Sea to Tunis this fall and keep it out of the Ionian and eastern Mediterranean, honoring our understanding. My armies are retaking Rome and Venice. Let’s keep the Italian-Turkish border quiet.
I’m retaking Rome and Venice and sending F Tyrrhenian Sea to Tunis this fall. I’ll continue to keep out of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon; please keep the western border quiet as agreed.

Russia here. Fall 1901: I'd like F DEN to stay out of Sweden and A BER to stay out of Prussia. Are you moving F DEN or A MUN against Holland or Belgium? I'll keep my fleets out of Denmark if you keep F KIE and A BER off Warsaw and Sevastopol approaches. Please confirm your intentions.

Your units can contest Greece from Serbia or Albania, while my A BUL can move there. I propose you take Serbia and leave Greece to me this autumn; please keep A SER and F ALB out of Greece. I’ll keep my forces away from your home centers.
I’ll keep F ANK out of the Black Sea as agreed. Please keep F RUM from moving to Bulgaria, and let me know your autumn plans for Rumania and the Balkans. I’m considering A BUL to Greece.
I’m considering A BUL to Greece this autumn. Can we keep the Ionian and eastern Mediterranean quiet? Please keep F TYS out of the Ionian and Greece, and tell me whether you plan to contest Greece.
Understood. I’ll keep my units clear of Venice and won’t move against your centers this fall. F Albania is still aimed at Greece; I have no plans to move toward your territory.

I’ve already committed F Albania to Greece with A Serbia supporting. I won’t agree to leave Greece uncontested this autumn, though I’ll keep my forces away from your home centers and avoid a clash over Bulgaria.

England here. Confirmed: F Mao stays out of the Channel and North Sea, and I will not move into Belgium. F Nth and F Nwg are heading north toward Norway and the Norwegian Sea, not against you. Your Pic-Bel and Mao-Por plan is fine by me. Keep Brest out of Irish waters and we stay calm.

England to Germany: I'm moving F Nth and F Nwg north-east toward Norway and the Norwegian Sea, not toward Skagerrak or Helgoland. Kiel-Denmark and Holland is your business. I'll keep my fleets out of Helgoland and the Baltic approaches. Let's keep the North Sea calm and revisit in 1902.

I’ll keep F MAO out of the Irish Sea, Channel, and North Sea as agreed; it is headed to Portugal, and A Picardy is going to Belgium. Please keep F NTH out of Belgium. I’m happy to discuss a reciprocal arrangement for Belgium and Norway next turn.

My plan is A Pic-Bel and F Den-Hol, with our Burgundy DMZ intact. Please keep your units out of Belgium this autumn; you can take Holland. I can’t promise support against Italy later, but I’m willing to keep the western border peaceful while we coordinate.

I’ll keep out of Piedmont and the western Mediterranean, and F MAO is moving to Portugal. A Picardy is going to Belgium. Please keep your units clear of Spain and the Gulf of Lyon as agreed; I have no plans to interfere with your moves for Tunis.

Germany to Russia: F Denmark is not moving into Sweden, and A Berlin stays out of Prussia as you ask. My fleet is heading for Holland, not Denmark. Keep F Finland and A Moscow out of Prussia and Denmark, and I'll keep my units away from Warsaw and Sevastopol. Sweden and Norway remain yours to take.

Germany to France: Holland via F Den-Hol is what I intend. Belgium is not something I'll concede cheaply, though. I'll stay out of Belgium this autumn if you keep A Picardy out of Burgundy and Ruhr and keep the Burgundy DMZ intact. Let's aim for a clean western border and discuss Italy later.

Understood. I’ll keep my units out of Spain and the Gulf of Lyon; F TYS is going to Tunis, and my armies are retaking Rome and Venice. I’ll continue to honor our quiet border and stay out of Piedmont.

I have no plans to contest Greece or move into the Balkans this autumn. I’ll keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste, and my other units are retaking Rome and Venice while F TYS goes to Tunis. Please keep your units clear of my centers.
I’m not contesting Greece this autumn. F TYS is going to Tunis, not the Ionian or Greece, and I’ll keep the eastern border quiet as agreed. You can pursue Greece without interference from me.

Russia here. F Finland and A Moscow will not enter Prussia or Denmark this autumn. I plan Sweden and Norway, so I expect F Denmark to stay out of Sweden. If you keep A Berlin and F Kiel away from Warsaw and Sevastopol, we remain at peace.

Russia here. F Rumania will stay out of Serbia and Bulgaria this fall. I'm keeping my position in Rumania and Galicia calm as well. Please keep A Serbia and F Albania out of Rumania and Ukraine, and let's keep Galicia clear.

Russia here. F Rumania is not moving to Bulgaria this fall. I'm holding the Black Sea line as agreed, and F Sevastopol stays out of Rumania for now. If A Bulgaria goes to Greece, that suits me, as long as your fleets stay out of Sevastopol.

I’ll keep F Ankara out of the eastern Mediterranean and won’t contest your Tunis move. I intend to move A Bulgaria to Greece this fall; please keep F Tyrrhenian out of the Ionian and Greece, as proposed, so we can avoid a clash.
I’ll move A Bulgaria to Greece and keep it out of Serbia. Please keep F Albania and A Serbia out of Greece this fall; you can secure Serbia, and we can each take a Balkan center without a clash.

I intend to keep A TYR out of Venice and will not move against your centers this spring. Please keep A VEN out of Tyrolia and Trieste; can we maintain the calm border while you consolidate your home centers?

Now that we each hold a Balkan center, let's avoid a clash over Greece and Bulgaria this spring. What are your plans for A BUL and F CON? I propose we keep our forces out of each other's centers and coordinate against any Russian pressure.
I plan to keep Galicia clear this spring. Please confirm A WAR will stay out of Galicia and tell me your intentions for F RUM—will it remain there rather than pressure Serbia or Bulgaria?

England to France: Spring 1902. Your A Bel and A Pic were supposed to go to Belgium; Belgium is now held by you, so I'll respect it. I'm moving toward Norway and Denmark area, not Belgium. Confirm F Bre stays out of the Channel and F Por/Mao stays away from Irish waters, and we keep the west calm.

England to Germany: With Kiel heading to Denmark and Holland, I'm not contesting Denmark. My fleets stay out of Helgoland and the Baltic. Are you still planning anything against Holland? If Holland is your target, tell me now so we avoid a misunderstanding in the North Sea this spring.

England to Russia: Our interests overlap in Norway and Sweden. I'm pushing into Norway this turn and have no plans against Sweden or St. Petersburg. Would you keep your fleets out of the North Sea and Norwegian Sea, and let Sweden stay yours? I'd prefer a quiet northern front while we both deal with Germany.

I’ll keep F Brest and F Portugal out of the Channel and North Sea. Please keep F Holland and your other units out of Belgium this spring; what are your plans for the Low Countries? I’m open to coordinating a peaceful western front.

I intend to keep A Paris out of Burgundy and would like our DMZ to continue. Belgium is French; please keep A Ruhr and F Hel out of it. What are your plans for Holland and the western border this spring?

Our quiet border has worked well. I’ll continue to keep my units out of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon; please do the same. Are you planning any moves toward the western Mediterranean or Spain this spring?

Germany to England: I see F HOL is yours, so my fleet plans in Holland are off. Are you holding Holland, or moving it to Belgium or the North Sea? I'll keep F HEL out of the North Sea if you keep your fleets away from Kiel and Berlin. Please confirm.

Germany to France: A BEL is in your hands, so the Belgium deal is moot for now. I'll keep A RUH out of Burgundy and Belgium if you keep A PAR and A PIC away from Munich and Ruhr. Will you hold the Burgundy DMZ this spring?

Germany to Russia: I'm keeping A BER and F HEL out of Prussia, Sweden and Denmark this spring. Please confirm A WAR and A STP stay out of Prussia and Berlin, and that F SWE does not move into Denmark or Kiel. We can keep the Baltic quiet.
Can we keep our border quiet this spring? I have no move planned against your centers. What are your plans for Greece and the Adriatic, and can you keep F Trieste clear of the Ionian?
I’d like to keep our western border quiet. I won’t move against Piedmont or the Gulf of Lyon; please keep clear of my centers and let me know your plans for Spain and the western Mediterranean.
Can we continue our quiet understanding this spring? I’m not planning a move against you. What are your plans for Greece and the Ionian? I’d like to coordinate so our fleets don’t block one another.

Russia to Turkey: Spring 1902. Your A Bulgaria and F Ankara are the main question. I have F Rumania and F Sevastopol holding the Black Sea line. Are you moving A Bulgaria to Greece or Serbia? I'll keep F Rumania out of Bulgaria if your fleets stay out of Sevastopol and Rumania.

With F GRE and A SER in place, what are your spring plans? I want to avoid a Balkan clash. Could we agree you hold Serbia and I move A BUL to Greece, while keeping our units out of each other's home centers?
Can we renew our Black Sea understanding for 1902? I will keep F ANK and F CON out of the Black Sea; please keep F SEV out as well. What are F RUM and your southern units doing this spring?
I intend to keep the Italian border quiet this spring. Please keep F TUN out of the Ionian and eastern Mediterranean; I’ll keep my fleets away from Italy. Are you considering any move toward Greece?

Agreed: I’ll keep F Trieste out of the Ionian and A Tyrolia out of Venice. I plan to hold Serbia and Greece this spring and won’t move against your centers. Please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste as agreed.

I can agree to keep A Serbia out of Greece, but I intend to keep F Greece there rather than yield the center. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Greece and hold Bulgaria; I’ll keep my forces away from your home centers. We can coordinate against Russian pressure without a clash.

England to Germany: F Hol is holding in Holland this spring, not moving to Belgium or the North Sea. I have no plans against Kiel or Berlin. Keep F Hel out of the North Sea and we stay friendly. If you move against Holland later, we will have a problem, so keep your fleets in the Baltic and Denmark.

England to France: F Hol holds in Holland this spring. I will not move into Belgium; your A Bel is yours. F Nth and A Lon are not heading toward Brest or Mao. Keep F Bre and F Por out of the Channel and Irish waters, and we stay calm in the west.

Confirmed: F Brest stays out of the Channel, and F Portugal will stay clear of Irish waters. I’ll keep A Belgium at home and ask you to keep F Holland and your other units out of Belgium. What are your plans for Holland and the Low Countries? A calm western front suits me.

Yes, I’ll honor the Burgundy DMZ: A Paris stays out of Burgundy, and A Picardy will stay clear of Munich and Ruhr. Please keep A Ruhr and F Hel out of Belgium. I’m not seeking a clash over Holland; let me know your plans for the western border.

I’ll keep clear of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon, and have no plans to move against your centers. I’m considering a quiet turn in Spain and the western Mediterranean, with no move against Italy. Please continue to avoid those border waters and let me know your own plans.

Germany to England: F Holland is yours, so I am not moving on Holland this spring. My F Helgoland stays out of the North Sea and I have no fleet heading for Norway. Keep your fleets away from Kiel and Berlin and we stay calm. I may revisit the North Sea in autumn if things change.

Germany to France: Yes, I'll keep the Burgundy DMZ this spring. A Ruhr stays out of Belgium and A Munich stays out of Burgundy, as long as A Paris and A Picardy stay out of Munich and Ruhr. Belgium is yours now. Our western border is quiet for 1902, and Italy can wait until later.
Agreed: A Venice will stay out of Tyrolia and Trieste, and I have no plans against your centers. Please keep F Trieste out of the Ionian; what are your plans for Greece and the Adriatic this spring?

I’m not planning a move toward Greece; F Tunis will stay out of the Ionian and eastern Mediterranean this spring. Please keep your fleets clear of Italian centers, and let me know whether you intend to move A Bulgaria onward.
I’ll continue to keep out of Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon. I have no move planned against Spain or the western Mediterranean this spring, and ask that you keep clear of my centers.

Russia to England: I have no quarrel with you in the north. Sweden and Norway are my interest, though, so I'll be moving F SWE and A STP into the Norwegian area as needed. If you take Norway, I will not contest it this spring; I'd rather you keep the North Sea and leave Sweden and St. Petersburg to me. Let's keep the peace.

I’ll keep F ANK and F CON out of the Black Sea and Rumania. A BUL will move to Greece; please keep F RUM out of Bulgaria and F SEV out of the Black Sea. Let’s maintain the line while we both secure our centers.

I plan A BUL to Greece, with F CON holding. Please hold Serbia and keep F GRE out of Greece so we avoid a clash; I’ll keep my units out of your home centers. We can coordinate against Russian pressure without crossing each other.

I’ll keep my fleets out of the Ionian and away from Italy. I plan A BUL to Greece, not a fleet move toward the Ionian. Please keep F TUN out of the Ionian and Greece, and we can keep the border quiet.

I intend to keep F Greece in Greece and A Serbia out of Greece this fall. Please keep A Bulgaria out of Greece and hold Bulgaria; in return I’ll keep my forces away from your home centers. Can we maintain the Balkan truce?
A Galicia is now in place, and I have no intention of moving it into your centers. Please keep A Warsaw out of Galicia and F Romania out of Serbia; can we keep this border quiet this fall?
I’ll honor our quiet-border agreement: F Adriatic will stay out of the Ionian, and A Bohemia will stay out of Venice. Please keep A Venice out of Tyrolia and Trieste this fall.

England to Russia: Fall 1902. Norway is my target this autumn. Sweden is yours, as agreed. I'd ask F Swe not to move against Norway or into the North Sea, and A Stp to stay out of Norway. I'll keep my fleets out of Denmark and the Baltic. Can you confirm?

For autumn, please keep F Holland and F North Sea out of Belgium and the Channel. I’ll keep F Gascony and F Mid-Atlantic Ocean away from the Channel and Irish Sea. What are your plans for the Low Countries and Denmark?

I’ll continue to honor the Burgundy DMZ and keep A Paris and A Picardy clear of Ruhr and Munich. Please keep A Ruhr and F Helgoland out of Belgium. What are your autumn plans for Holland and the western border?

I’d like to keep our western border quiet as agreed. I have no plan against Piedmont or the Gulf of Lyon; please keep clear of Spain and those waters. What are your intentions for the western Mediterranean this autumn?

Germany to Russia: Fall 1902. I hold F Denmark-area plans off for now. Are you moving A Warsaw or A Stp against Prussia or Berlin? I am keeping A Ber and F Hel out of Prussia, Sweden and Denmark. Please confirm F Swe stays out of Denmark and Kiel, and tell me your Galicia and Ukraine intentions.
I’ll keep my units clear of your centers this fall. F ADR is close to my coast; can you confirm it won’t move against Italy? I’m also interested in your plans for Greece and the Balkans.
Are you still planning A BUL-GRE this fall? I can keep F TYS out of the Ionian and Greece if you confirm your fleets will stay clear of Italian waters. Let me know your intentions before orders.

Let’s maintain our quiet western border this fall: I’ll avoid Piedmont and the Gulf of Lyon. Please keep your units clear of my centers and let me know whether you plan any moves near the western Mediterranean.

Russia to Germany: Fall 1902. Denmark is unowned and Sweden is my target. Will F Kiel or A Berlin move toward Denmark or Warsaw this autumn? I will keep F Sweden and A Warsaw off Prussia and Kiel if you confirm your fleets stay out of Denmark and Sweden.

I intend to move A BUL to Greece, supported by F CON. Please keep A SER from supporting F GRE so we can avoid a wider Balkan clash; I’ll keep my units out of your home centers. You can hold Serbia while I take Greece.

I propose renewing the Black Sea understanding: I’ll keep F ARM and F CON out of the Black Sea, and ask you to keep F SEV out as well. What are your plans for F RUM and the southern front this fall? I’m focused on Greece.

I’ll keep my fleets away from the Ionian and Italian centers this fall. Are you keeping F NAF out of the eastern Mediterranean? I intend to contest Greece with A BUL, supported by F CON, and would like to keep our border quiet.

F ADR will not move against Italy; I’ll keep it out of the Ionian and your centers. I plan to hold Greece and Serbia and keep A BOH out of Venice. Please keep A VEN out of Tyrolia and Trieste as agreed.

I cannot yield Greece after holding it through spring. I’ll keep A SER from supporting F GRE, but F GRE will hold; please keep A BUL in Bulgaria rather than moving to Greece. I’ll keep my forces away from your home centers, and we can avoid a wider clash.

England here. My plan this autumn is Norway, with F Nth and F Nwg, and my fleets stay out of Belgium and the Channel. F Hol stays in Holland and will not go to Belgium. Keep F Gas and F Mao out of the Channel and Irish Sea, and we stay calm in the west. I have no interest in Denmark.

I’ll keep A Marseille out of Piedmont and F Gascony out of the Gulf of Lyon. F Mid-Atlantic will remain clear of the western Mediterranean; I intend to secure Portugal and Spain, not threaten your centers. Please keep F Tunis and F Tyrrhenian out of the Gulf of Lyon and away from Spain.

Germany to Russia: I'll keep A Ber and F Hel out of Prussia, Sweden and Denmark this autumn, as I've said. Your F Swe staying out of Denmark and Kiel is key for me. Denmark is unowned, so I may take it if it's open, but not from Sweden. Keep A Warsaw off Prussia and Berlin and we stay at peace. I'm not moving on Galicia or Ukraine; your Galicia-facing units are your business.

Germany to France: Autumn plans: F Hel and A Ruh stay put this turn, neither entering Belgium or Burgundy. I'm not moving on Holland this autumn; England holds it. Keep A Paris and A Picardy away from Munich and Ruhr and the Burgundy DMZ holds. Italy is your business to discuss with Italy, not with me now.
Agreed: A VEN will stay out of Tyrolia and Trieste, and I have no move against your centers. I understand F ADR will stay out of the Ionian. What are your plans for Greece and the Balkans this fall?
I’ll keep clear of Spain and the Gulf of Lyon, and have no plans against your western centers. F NAF will remain out of the western waters this fall. Please keep your units clear of my centers.

Yes, F NAF will stay out of the eastern Mediterranean, and F TYS will stay out of the Ionian and Greece. I understand A BUL, supported by F CON, is contesting Greece; I won’t interfere, and appreciate your fleets staying clear of Italian centers.

Russia to England: Fall 1902. I will not move F Swe into the North Sea or Norway, and A Stp stays out of Norway. Norway is yours to take this autumn. I expect your fleets to stay out of the Baltic and Denmark, and Sweden stays mine.

Russia to Germany: I have no plans against Prussia or Berlin this autumn. A Warsaw stays out of Prussia and Galicia. F Sweden will not enter Denmark or Kiel. Please keep A Berlin and F Kiel away from Warsaw and Sevastopol, and we stay at peace.
Russia to Austria: Agreed, I will keep A Warsaw out of Galicia and F Rumania out of Serbia this fall. Let us keep this border quiet. Please keep A Galicia out of Ukraine and Rumania in return.

Russia to Turkey: I renew the Black Sea understanding. F Sevastopol stays out of the Black Sea, and F Rumania stays out of Bulgaria this fall. Please keep F Ankara and F Constantinople out of Sevastopol and Rumania. I am focused on Sweden and the north, so Greece is yours.

Yes, A BUL-GRE supported by F CON remains my plan. F ARM and F CON will stay clear of the Ionian and Italian centers, and I’ll keep our border quiet. Please keep F NAF out of the eastern Mediterranean as proposed.

I intend to proceed with A BUL-GRE, supported by F CON. If A SER stays out of the contest, you can hold Serbia and I can take Greece without widening the conflict. I’ll keep my units out of your home centers; I ask that you not support F GRE’s defense.

I intend to keep F GRE in Greece and A SER out of your centers. Please keep A BUL in Bulgaria and F AEG away from Greece; can we agree to avoid a contest over Greece and coordinate against Russian pressure?
Can we keep the border quiet this spring? Please keep F RUM out of Serbia and A WAR out of Galicia. I’ll keep A SER out of Rumania and won’t move against your centers; tell me your plans for F RUM.

A Ruhr will move to Burgundy this turn; A Munich will stay out of Berlin and Kiel. Please keep A Berlin, A Kiel, and F Denmark out of Ruhr, Burgundy, and Belgium, as you proposed, so we can settle the border.

I’ll move A Munich to Bohemia this autumn to stretch Austria’s northern defense. A Ruhr is moving to Burgundy, so I cannot support Munich’s move. Let me know whether F Adriatic and A Tyrolia are renewing the pressure on Trieste.

Germany to England: Thanks. I keep F Denmark and A Kiel defensive this autumn and will not enter Holland or the North Sea. If I move west against France I will tell you first, and I expect your fleets to stay out of Denmark and Kiel.

Germany to Russia: Agreed in principle. I keep A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark at home this autumn and do not plan any move against Prussia or Sweden. Keep A Warsaw and F Sweden out of Berlin and Denmark, and we both gain more by focusing elsewhere. Tell me your Galicia plans so we avoid collision.

Germany to France: My A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark stay home this autumn if A Ruhr withdraws to Belgium or Burgundy now. Holding Ruhr is a threat I cannot ignore. Give me a written yes on Ruhr. Keep A Munich away from Kiel and Berlin, and we avoid a clash.

I’m renewing pressure on Trieste with F ADR, likely supported by A TYR. A MUN–BOH would help draw Austria’s attention, if you can spare it; otherwise keep A RUH clear of Tyrolia and Italian centers. I’ll keep F TYS out of Greece.

I can’t agree to leave Trieste uncontested while your F TRI remains there. I’m considering another supported attempt from F ADR with A TYR. I’ll keep A ROM away from your centers, but won’t promise to keep F ADR out of Trieste.

I plan to pressure Trieste from F ADR, not Greece or the Aegean; F TYS will stay out of Greece. Your supported contest of Greece could stretch Austria’s defense. Please keep your fleets clear of Italian waters and A BUL away from Italian centers.

Russia to England: I will not move F Swe or A Stp into Norway or the North Sea this autumn. Keep your fleets out of the Baltic and Denmark and we stay friendly. I have no plans against Rumania-facing powers at present; my focus is Sweden and the north. Confirm your North Sea orders for NTH and NOR.

A BUL and A CON will stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this fall, and F ARM will stay clear of your centers. Please keep F RUM and F SEV defensive and out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea; I intend no move against you.

I intend to renew pressure on Austria’s Greece, not enter Italian waters or centers. Please keep F ADR out of Greece and the Aegean; your pressure on Trieste can proceed without Turkish interference. Are you moving F TYS toward the Adriatic?

I can’t agree to leave Greece uncontested: I intend to challenge F GRE this fall, while keeping A BUL out of Serbia and my forces clear of your home centers. I understand you plan F GRE hold with A SER support. Please keep A SER out of Bulgaria.

F TRI remains defended, and I can support it from BUD. Let’s stop spending units on this border: please keep F ADR out of TRI and A TYR out of Tyrolia; I’ll keep A SER and F GRE away from your centers. What are your plans for F ADR and A TYR?

F GRE is still defended by A SER. Please keep F AEG and A BUL out of Greece this spring, and keep A BUL out of Serbia; I’ll keep A SER clear of Bulgaria and my forces clear of your centers. What are your plans for F AEG and A BUL?

Can we keep the eastern border quiet this spring? I’ll keep A UKR out of Rumania and A SER out of your centers. Please keep F RUM out of Serbia and A WAR out of Galicia. What are your plans for F RUM and A WAR?

England to France, Spring 1907: Your A Bel sits beside my F Hol and your A Bur, A Gas and F Pic are close to my north. Please confirm A Bel stays out of Holland and F Pic stays out of the Channel this spring. I hold F Hol and F Nth. Are you planning anything against Belgium?

England to Germany, Spring 1907: I am holding F Hol, F Nth and F Nor. Please confirm F Den and A Kie stay out of Holland and the North Sea. If you move west against France, tell me first so we can coordinate before the Channel and Belgium are contested.

England to Russia, Spring 1907: Please confirm F Swe and A Stp stay out of Norway and the North Sea this spring. I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Denmark. Tell me your plans for Rumania and Galicia, since Austria is active there.

The border is now quiet: my A Ruhr moved to Burgundy and A Munich stayed out of Berlin and Kiel. What are A Berlin, A Kiel, and F Denmark doing this spring? I’m considering moves into Munich and Ruhr; I’d prefer you keep your forces out of Burgundy and Belgium.

I’ll keep A Belgium out of Holland and F Picardy out of the Channel, as agreed. Please keep F Holland, F North Sea, and F Norway out of Belgium and the Channel this spring. I’m focused on the central front; can we maintain the western quiet?

Austria remains a common target. Are F Adriatic and A Tyrolia renewing pressure on Trieste this spring? My A Bohemia can threaten Munich, but I’m weighing pressure on Germany too. Let me know what you plan so we avoid interfering with each other.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1907: Your A Warsaw, A Moscow and F Sweden are close to Berlin and Denmark. I hold A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark and will not move toward Sweden or Warsaw this spring. Please confirm you won't move on Prussia or Denmark. Tell me if F Sweden goes to Denmark or Kiel.

Germany to France, Spring 1907: Your A Burgundy and A Bohemia are on my southern border. I am holding Berlin, Kiel and Denmark and will not enter Burgundy, Ruhr or Belgium. Keep A Bohemia out of Silesia and Munich-adjacent moves toward my home centers, and we can both focus elsewhere. Please answer in writing.

Your F TRI and A SER remain the main obstacles to a stable border. What are your plans for TRI and GRE this spring? I’m considering a renewed push on Trieste, but would prefer to know whether you intend to widen the conflict.

Can we coordinate pressure on Austria this spring? I’m considering an attack on Trieste; could you contest Greece from A BUL with support from A CON? I’ll keep F ION clear of Greece and the Aegean. Please keep your forces away from Italian centers.

Will A BOH pressure Austria this spring, perhaps toward VIE, while I renew pressure on TRI? That would stretch Austria’s defense. I’ll keep my forces out of French centers and waters; let me know your plans.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1907: Your A Ukraine sits next to my Sevastopol and Moscow area and your Serbia-Bulgaria-Rumania front is tense. Tell me plainly: is A UKR staying put or moving to Rumania? I will hold F RUM and A WAR defensively this spring if you confirm no move into Rumania or Warsaw.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1907: Your A Bulgaria and A Constantinople have been reliable, so I will keep F Rumania and F Sevastopol holding. Please confirm in writing that A BUL, A CON and F BLA stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this spring, and tell me your exact Greece and Aegean plans.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1907: My F Sweden will hold this spring and my A Warsaw stays out of Prussia. Please confirm A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark stay home. I am watching F Denmark closely, so tell me if you plan any Baltic or Sweden move.

I intend to contest Greece again: A BUL-GRE supported by A CON and F AEG. Keep A SER supporting F GRE if you choose, but please keep A SER out of Bulgaria; I’ll keep A CON and F BLA clear of your centers.

I’m renewing pressure on Greece with A BUL, supported by A CON and F AEG. Please keep F ADR and F ION out of Greece and the Aegean; I’ll keep my forces clear of Italian centers. What are your plans around Trieste?
I’ll keep A BUL, A CON, and F BLA away from Rumania and Sevastopol this spring. Please keep F RUM and F SEV out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea. What are your plans for those fleets?

A UKR will stay out of Rumania and Warsaw this spring; I’m not planning a move into either. Please keep F RUM out of Serbia and A WAR out of Galicia. I intend to hold the Balkan line and would welcome a quiet eastern border.

I will keep A SER out of Bulgaria, but F GRE will remain defended by A SER. A BUL-GRE with support from A CON and F AEG threatens my center, so I will meet it. Please keep A BUL and F AEG out of Greece; I have no plans against your centers if you do.

F TRI will stay, supported from BUD if needed, and F GRE will remain defended by A SER. I’m not looking to widen the conflict, but another attack on Trieste or Greece will be resisted. Keep F ADR out of TRI and A TYR out of Tyrolia, and I’ll keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers.

England to France: Confirmed for Spring 1907. A Bel stays out of Holland, F Pic stays out of the Channel, and I hold F Hol, F Nth and F Nor, none entering Belgium or the Channel. Please also keep F Wes and F Gol out of the Channel and Irish Sea. If you break this, I will have to reassess my own options in the west. Keep the central front pressing.
A Belgium will stay out of Holland and F Picardy will stay out of the Channel. I have no plan against Belgium; I’m focused east. Please keep F Holland and F North Sea out of Belgium and the Channel.

A Bohemia will stay out of Silesia, and I will not move A Munich toward Berlin or Kiel. I’m considering pressure on Munich and Ruhr; please keep Berlin, Kiel, and Denmark out of Burgundy, Ruhr, and Belgium as you offered.

Yes—A Bohemia can pressure Austria, but I’m not promising a move to Vienna before seeing your plan. Are F Adriatic and A Tyrolia moving against Trieste again? I’ll keep French units clear of Italian centers and waters.

Germany to England, Spring 1907: Confirmed, F Denmark and A Kiel stay home this spring and I will not move into Holland or the North Sea. If I ever move west against France, I will tell you first. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark and Kiel in return.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1907: A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark hold this spring. I will not move on Sweden or Warsaw. In return, keep F Sweden and A Warsaw out of Prussia, Berlin and Denmark. If F Sweden moves toward Denmark or Kiel, I will regard that as hostile.

Germany to France, Spring 1907: A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark hold this spring, and I will not enter Burgundy, Ruhr or Belgium. Munich and Ruhr are your business only if you keep A Munich out of Kiel and Berlin. Any move into Ruhr by you will be seen as a breach of our understanding.

I’m renewing pressure on Trieste with F ADR and A TYR. A BOH–VIE would be useful to stretch Austria, provided it doesn’t interfere with your plans against Germany. I’ll keep Italian forces out of French centers and waters.

I intend to keep contesting Trieste; I can’t promise to keep F ADR out while F TRI remains there. I’ll keep A TYR out of Tyrolia and avoid your other centers for now. A SER and F GRE staying clear of Italian centers will help contain the conflict.

I plan to pressure Trieste with F ADR, while A TYR supports the attack. F ION will stay clear of Greece and the Aegean. Your supported contest of Greece would stretch Austria; please keep your forces away from Italian centers.

Russia to England: Confirmed for Spring 1907: F Swe and A Stp will not move into Norway or the North Sea. I have no plans against Denmark or the Baltic fleets you mention. Rumania and Galicia remain under watch; I will hold F Rum and A War defensively this spring. Keep NTH and NOR clear of my area.

Confirmed: A BUL, A CON, and F BLA will stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this spring. I intend A BUL-GRE, with A CON and F AEG supporting; F BLA will hold. Please keep F RUM and F SEV defensive and out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea.

I intend to contest Greece: A BUL-GRE, supported by A CON and F AEG. I’ll keep A BUL out of Serbia and A CON and F BLA clear of your centers. Your F GRE with A SER support may hold; I’m coordinating pressure on Trieste with Italy.

Yes, I’ll contest Greece with A BUL-GRE supported by A CON and F AEG. Please keep F ION out of Greece and the Aegean, and keep your forces clear of my centers. I have no orders planned against Italian centers; your pressure on Trieste can proceed.

Your A VIE is sitting in my home center, and A MUN is poised beside it. Please move A VIE out of Vienna this fall and keep A MUN out of my centers. I’ll avoid your centers; otherwise I must treat this as an attack and defend accordingly.

Can we stop the Trieste fight this fall? Please keep F ADR out of TRI and A TYR out of my centers; I’ll keep A SER and F GRE away from Italian centers. France is already in Vienna, so I need to avoid opening another front.

Please keep A BUL and F AEG out of Greece this fall. I’ll hold F GRE and keep A SER out of Bulgaria. France now occupies Vienna, so a quiet Balkan border would let us both avoid wasting forces on each other.

England to France, Fall 1907: Your A Bel has been beside my F Hol for years. Please confirm A Bel stays out of Holland and F Pic stays out of the Channel this autumn. I hold F Hol, F Nth and F Nor and will not enter Belgium. If you move on Belgium or Holland, I will reassess my western options.

England to Germany, Fall 1907: Still holding F Hol, F Nth and F Nor. Please confirm F Den and A Kie stay out of Holland and the North Sea. If you plan anything against France through Belgium or Ruhr, tell me first so we can coordinate before the Channel is contested.

England to Russia, Fall 1907: Please confirm F Swe and A Stp stay out of Norway and the North Sea this autumn. I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Denmark. What are your plans for Rumania and Galicia against Austria? I'd value your reply before spring.
Austria is under pressure from several sides. What are F ADR and A TYR doing this fall? I can coordinate A VIE and A MUN against Austria, provided we agree which centers each of us is taking.

My A VIE is in your territory, but I’m open to a settlement rather than a needless fight. What are your plans for A SER and F TRI this fall? I can discuss a demilitarized line if you’ll keep your forces away from my centers.
Can we maintain the western understanding this fall? I’ll keep F PIC out of the Channel and my forces out of Holland. Please keep F HOL and F NTH out of Belgium and the Channel.

Germany to France, Fall 1907: Your A Munich and A Ruhr are at my border. I hold Berlin, Kiel and Denmark. Which of your units is entering Ruhr, Burgundy or Belgium this autumn? Give me a clear answer, since I will not allow Munich to threaten Kiel or Berlin.

Your F TRI still blocks my access, and I may renew pressure with F ADR supported by A TYR. Will A BUD support TRI again this fall? If you’ll accept a settlement, keep F TRI out of the Adriatic and I’ll avoid your other centers.
Can you renew the supported attack on Greece with A BUL, A CON and F AEG this fall? I’ll keep F ADR and F ALB clear of Greece and the Aegean while I decide whether to press Trieste.

Austria remains exposed with A VIE and A MUN under pressure. Are you moving A VIE or A MUN against Austria this fall? I may again pressure Trieste from F ADR with A TYR; please keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1907: A UKR sits beside my SEV and MOS. Your Spring word was no move into Rumania or Warsaw. Confirm A UKR holds or goes elsewhere, not RUM or WAR. If you keep the Balkan line, I will keep F RUM defensive, but I need your exact Fall orders in writing.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1907: Your Spring move on Greece is noted. A BUL, A CON and F ARM must not enter Rumania or Sevastopol. Tell me plainly whether you will attack Greece or Serbia this Fall, and confirm F BLA stays out of the Black Sea coast near SEV.

Russia to Germany, Fall 1907: F Sweden holds and A Warsaw stays out of Prussia. I will not move toward Denmark or Kiel. Confirm A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark stay home this Fall. If you plan any move toward Sweden or Warsaw, tell me now.

France is now in Vienna, so your southern position looks increasingly exposed. I intend to renew the contest for Greece from A BUL, supported by A CON and F AEG. Will A SER still support F GRE, or are you redirecting it? I’ll keep my other units clear of your centers.

With France in Vienna, let’s keep pressure on Austria coordinated. I propose A BUL-GRE with support from A CON and F AEG; please keep F ADR and F ALB out of Greece and the Aegean. Are you again targeting Trieste, and with what support?

I intend no move against your centers this autumn: A BUL and A CON will stay out of Rumania, and F ARM will stay clear of Sevastopol. Please keep F RUM and F SEV defensive and out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea. What are your plans for those fleets?
A UKR will hold this fall: no move to RUM or WAR. I’ll keep A SER on the Balkan line and have no plans against your centers. Please keep F RUM defensive and A WAR out of GAL.
A SER will remain on the Balkan line and F TRI will defend my position. A VIE must leave Vienna this fall; keep A MUN out of my centers. I’ll keep my forces away from yours if you withdraw from VIE.

Yes, A BUD will support F TRI this fall. I can’t accept a settlement that leaves TRI exposed: keep F ADR out of TRI and A TYR out of my centers, and I’ll keep A SER and F GRE away from Italian centers.

A SER will support F GRE again; I cannot leave Greece undefended against the attack you describe. Keep A BUL out of GRE and SER, and F AEG out of GRE. I have no plans against your centers if you refrain from attacking mine.

England to France: Confirmed, I hold F Hol, F Nth and F Nor and will not enter Belgium or the Channel. Your A Bel stays out of Holland and F Pic stays out of the Channel, as agreed. Note your A Bel and F Pic are close to my fleets, so any move on Belgium or Holland would force me to reassess my western options. Keep the central front pressing.

A MUN will not move toward Berlin or Kiel. I intend to keep A RUH out of Burgundy and Belgium this autumn; I cannot promise to leave Ruhr untouched indefinitely, but I am not entering it this turn. Keep your units out of our western border and we can preserve the quiet.

Confirmed: A BEL stays out of Holland and F PIC stays out of the Channel this autumn. I have no move planned against Belgium or Holland. Please keep F HOL and F NTH out of Belgium and the Channel as agreed.

I intend to press Austria, but I’m not committing A VIE or A MUN to a specific move until we coordinate centers. If F ADR and A TYR renew pressure on TRI, tell me your target; I’ll keep French forces clear of Italian centers.

I hear your warning. I’m willing to discuss a settlement, but cannot promise to vacate VIE while Italian and other forces threaten your position. Keep F TRI and A SER away from my centers and we can work toward a demilitarized line.

Germany to Russia, Fall 1907: A Berlin, A Kiel and F Denmark hold this Fall, and I will not move toward Sweden or Warsaw. I expect F Sweden and A Warsaw to stay out of Prussia, Berlin, Denmark and Kiel. If F Sweden moves toward Denmark, I will treat it as hostile and act accordingly.

Germany to England, Fall 1907: Confirmed, F Denmark and A Kiel stay home this Fall, and I will not move into Holland or the North Sea. I have no move planned into Belgium or Ruhr at present, and I will tell you first if that changes. Please keep your fleets out of Denmark and Kiel.

I’ll renew pressure on TRI with F ADR–TRI and A TYR supporting. Please use A VIE and A MUN against Austria, but avoid interfering with TRI or Italian centers. If TRI falls, I’ll take it; let me know which Austrian center you intend to secure.

I can’t promise to leave TRI alone while F TRI blocks my access. I’m considering F ADR against TRI with A TYR supporting. If you want to contain this, move F TRI out of TRI; I’ll keep A TYR out of your centers and avoid other Austrian centers.

I’ll keep F ADR and F ALB out of Greece and the Aegean. Your supported A BUL–GRE attack is useful pressure while France holds VIE. I’m considering F ADR–TRI with A TYR support; please keep your forces clear of Italian centers.

Russia to England: F Swe and A Stp will not move into Norway or the North Sea this autumn. I will keep my fleets out of the Baltic and Denmark as long as you do the same. Rumania and Galicia remain under my watch; Austria's A Ukraine is the real threat, so I may need to shift units south. Keep NTH and NOR clear of my area and we stay friendly.

Russia to Turkey: Your word is noted. I expect A Bul, A Con and F Arm to stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol, and F Blа must not enter the Black Sea coast near SEV. My F Rum and F Sev will hold defensively. Tell me plainly whether your Greece or Serbia attack is aimed at Austria, since I will watch the Balkans closely.

I will not attack Greece or Serbia this fall: A BUL-GRE, supported by A CON and F AEG. F ARM will stay out of Sevastopol, and I have no F BLA; my fleet is in ARM. Please keep F RUM and F SEV out of Bulgaria and the Black Sea.

Yes: A BUL-GRE with support from A CON and F AEG. Please keep F ADR and F ALB clear of Greece and the Aegean. I’ll keep my forces away from Italian centers. Let me know whether F ADR and A TYR are targeting Trieste.

I will renew the contest: A BUL-GRE, supported by A CON and F AEG. I understand France is in Vienna, but I won’t leave Greece uncontested. I’ll keep my other forces clear of your centers; please tell me whether A SER will still support F GRE.

A VIE remains in my home center, so I must act against it. Please move A VIE to BOH or TYR this spring and keep A MUN out of my centers; I will keep A SER and F GRE away from yours. If you stay in VIE, I’ll use A BUD and A SER against it.

France occupies VIE and I cannot afford another front. Please keep A TYR out of my centers and F TRI out of GRE; I’ll keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers. Are you planning to attack TRI again this spring?

With France in VIE, I need to avoid losing Greece as well. Please keep A BUL and F AEG out of GRE this spring; I’ll keep A SER out of BUL and my forces clear of your other centers. What are your orders for A BUL and F AEG?

England to France, Spring 1908: Your F Eng, A Bre, A Gas and A Bel are now all beside my London, Liverpool and North Sea fleets. Your F Eng is in the Channel, which we agreed to keep clear. Confirm F Eng leaves the Channel and the Irish Sea, and that A Bel stays out of Holland. What are your plans for Belgium and Picardy?

England to Germany, Spring 1908: You have moved units south in the last turns, so I need to know your plans. Please confirm F Den and A Kie stay out of Holland and the North Sea this spring. If you move against France through Belgium or Ruhr, tell me first so we can coordinate before the Channel is contested.

Let’s finish Austria without contesting each other: I can move A VIE to BUD while you continue against TRI. What are F ALB and A TYR doing this spring? Please keep them clear of BUD; I’ll keep French units out of Italian centers.
Can we preserve the western understanding this spring? I’ll keep A BEL out of HOL and F ENG out of the North Sea; please keep F HOL and F NTH out of Belgium and the Channel. My focus remains east.

I’m willing to keep the western front quiet this spring. A MUN will not move toward BER or KIE, and I’ll keep French units out of RUH and BEL. Please keep A BER and F DEN away from my centers while I focus east.

Germany to Russia, Spring 1908: France now holds Kiel and Munich with A Kie and A Mun, and I have only Berlin and Denmark. Russia and Germany both lose if France takes the north. I propose we hold Denmark and Berlin together and, when possible, unite against France. Will F Sweden and A Warsaw stay out of Berlin and Denmark this spring?

Germany to England, Spring 1908: France has A Kiel, A Munich and F Eng, and is building in the west. I am down to Berlin and Denmark. I propose that your F Nth and F Hol stay out of Denmark, and that we coordinate against French expansion, with you pressing the Channel and me holding Berlin. What are your spring orders?
Austria is reduced to BUD, SER, and GRE. What are your plans for A VIE and A MUN this spring? I’ll avoid French centers; let’s coordinate so we don’t interfere with each other while pressing Austria.
I’m not planning to attack your centers this spring. Please keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers, and tell me whether you intend to move against TRI or my other units.
What are your plans for A BUL and F AEG this spring? I’ll keep F ALB clear of Greece and the Aegean; please keep your forces away from Italian centers.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1908: Your fall word was A UKR holds, no move to RUM or WAR. Confirm your Spring orders in writing. I see A UKR is no longer listed, so tell me where your armies went. I will keep F RUM and A WAR defensive as long as you stay out of Galicia and Rumania.

Russia to France, Spring 1908: Your armies are massing around Munich and Marseille, and I see your new builds. I have no quarrel with you. Tell me if you intend anything against Germany or Italy this year, and I will keep my Baltic and Black Sea units home in return.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1908: Your A BUL and F AEG must stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol. You now show F BLA and A SMY, so confirm your Black Sea fleet stays away from SEV and that your Greece attack is not aimed at my southern flank. I will keep F RUM and F SEV defensive.

Austria is exposed with France in Vienna and your pressure on Trieste. This spring I can order A BUL–GRE with F AEG support; can F ALB support the same attack? I’ll keep F AEG out of Italian centers and won’t move against you.

France’s occupation of Vienna makes coordination against it more useful than fighting over Greece. I can keep A BUL and F AEG out of your centers this spring if you’ll keep A SER out of Bulgaria and tell me how you intend to defend against France.

I have F BLA and will keep it out of Sevastopol; I’m not planning a move against Rumania. What are F RUM and F SEV doing this spring? I’m assessing whether we can keep the Black Sea quiet while pressure shifts toward Austria and France.

A UKR was disbanded in the winter; I have no army there now. This spring I’ll keep A SER and F GRE on the Balkan line and make no move into Galicia or Rumania. Please keep F RUM defensive and A WAR out of Galicia.

I’ll keep A SER out of Bulgaria and use it to defend my remaining Balkan position against France. Please keep A BUL and F AEG out of Greece this spring; I’ll keep F GRE out of your centers. France in Vienna is the immediate threat, so let’s avoid opening another front.

I have no plans to move against Trieste or your other units this spring. I’ll keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers. Please keep A TYR out of my centers and F ADR out of TRI while I deal with France’s occupation of Vienna.

England to Germany: I can keep F Hol and F Nth out of Denmark for now, but France holds Kiel and Munich and has F Eng in the Channel, so your claim of Berlin and Denmark is unclear to me. Confirm A Kie and F Den are not moving into Holland, the North Sea, or Norway this spring. I will decide my western moves after seeing your reply.

I have no plans against Russia. My immediate focus is finishing Austria; I’m keeping French forces out of Italian centers and will maintain the understanding on your northern and Black Sea fronts. Germany remains quiet for now, though I’m not ruling out future moves there.

I’ll keep A BEL out of Holland, and F ENG will leave the Channel for the Irish Sea. A BRE and A GAS will stay clear of your centers. I’m not planning to move on Belgium or Picardy this spring; please keep F HOL and F NTH out of Belgium and the Channel.

I’ll move A VIE to BOH this spring and keep A MUN out of your centers. I expect A SER and F GRE to stay away from French centers as you offered. I’m coordinating with Italy to finish Austria, so this is a limited de-escalation, not a promise to abandon further pressure.

I’ll move A VIE to BUD and keep A MUN out of Austrian centers this spring. What are F ALB and A TYR doing? Please keep them clear of BUD while I take it; I’ll keep French units out of Italian centers and leave TRI to your pressure.

Germany to England, Spring 1908: Our positions have shifted. France has taken Kiel and Munich and I hold only Berlin and Denmark. I will not move F Den into Holland or the North Sea. I agree to coordinate against French expansion: you press the Channel and Belgium, I hold Berlin. Please keep your fleets away from Denmark, and tell me your spring orders so we avoid bumping.
I will not attack your centers this spring: F TRI will stay in TRI and A TYR will stay in TYR. Please keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers; I’m not planning a move against your units.
I can’t support A BUL–GRE with F ALB; I’ll keep F ALB clear of Greece and the Aegean. I’m not moving against your centers. Please keep your forces away from Italian centers.
F ALB stays in ALB and A TYR stays in TYR this spring; neither will enter BUD or interfere with your move A VIE–BUD. F TRI stays in TRI. I’ll keep Italian units clear of French centers.

Russia to Germany, Spring 1908: I agree that France is the greater danger to us both. F Sweden and A Warsaw will not move into Berlin or Denmark this spring. I'd ask you to keep A Berlin and F Denmark defensive toward Prussia and Sweden, and to tell me if you plan any move against Kiel or Munich so we can coordinate.

Russia to Turkey: F Rumania and F Sevastopol are holding defensively this spring and will not enter Bulgaria or the Black Sea. Keep F Blа and A Smy away from Sevastopol and Rumania, and I will do the same. Your Greece attack is your affair, but I expect you to keep Serbia and Austria's line in mind.

F BLA will hold in the Black Sea and will not move against Sevastopol; A BUL is aimed at Greece, not your southern flank. I have no move planned against Rumania. Please keep F RUM and F SEV defensive as proposed.

A BUL will move to GRE, supported by A SMY and F AEG. I’ll keep my other units clear of your centers, but I can’t leave Greece uncontested. France in Vienna is a serious threat; coordinate with Italy against it if you can.

A BUL will move to GRE with support from A SMY and F AEG. Please keep F ALB clear of Greece as proposed; I’ll keep my forces away from Italian centers. Your pressure on Trieste can help contain Austria while France occupies Vienna.

A VIE remains in Vienna despite your spring pledge to move it; I need to know your fall plan. Will A VIE move to BUD or hold? I can keep A SER and F GRE clear of your centers if you keep A MUN and A BOH out of BUD and SER.

Your spring attack on Greece was clear. What are A BUL and F AEG doing this fall? I can keep A SER out of Bulgaria if you leave F GRE alone; otherwise I’ll defend Greece and Serbia rather than open a front against you.

With France still pressuring my position, I need a quiet border. Will F TRI stay put and A TYR avoid BUD this fall? I’ll keep A SER and F GRE clear of Italian centers. Let me know if you’re coordinating with France against me.

With A SER exposed to Turkey, what are your plans for it this spring? I may move A VIE to SER; please keep A BUD out of SER and tell me whether you can resist Turkish pressure from BUD.
What are your plans for A GRE and A BUL this spring? I may move A VIE to SER, so I propose you keep A BUL out of SER and your fleets clear of ION and ADR while we avoid a wider clash.
My F MAR and A SPA can press your southern positions. What are your plans for F POR and A VIE? If you keep clear of Italian centers, I can limit my moves to the front line this spring.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1914: Your A Bul, A Gre and F Bla have had a quiet history with my Rumania and Sevastopol, and I intend to keep F Rum and F Sev in place. Yet Turkey now has A Arm and F Bla near my Caucasus and Sevastopol. Confirm A Arm stays out of Sevastopol and Armenia-Russia border, and tell me whether F Bla moves toward Rumania this spring.

With Austria reduced to BUD/SER and Italy holding CON with a fleet, I need to know your spring intentions. Will F RUM and F SEV stay out of the Balkans, and can A WAR avoid SER? I can keep A BUL and F BLA clear of RUM/SEV while I address the southern front.

Your F CON, F ADR, and F ION threaten my position directly. What are your spring orders? I propose we avoid attacks on GRE and the Turkish-held centers this turn; in return, I will keep A GRE clear of your centers. Please clarify whether F CON is staying put.

I expect Italy to be the immediate threat, especially with its F CON and A VIE. Are you willing to coordinate against Italy rather than continue the SER contest? Tell me your intended orders for A SER and A BUD; I can consider redirecting A BUL/A GRE if we can agree on a concrete plan.

I’ll keep A SER in SER and A BUD in BUD; I won’t assist Italy against you. Your A BUL/A GRE moves decide whether this can become cooperation: leave SER untouched this spring and we can coordinate pressure on France. I cannot promise to abandon either center while both Italy and Turkey threaten them.

I’ll defend with A SER holding and A BUD supporting it. Please keep A VIE out of SER; a move there would compound Turkey’s pressure and make cooperation impossible. I’ll keep A BUD clear of SER. Can you instead use A MUN to pressure A SIL or A GAL?

England to France: Agreed that F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers while no French unit enters Belgium, Holland, the Channel or Irish Sea. My BER and KIE are holding this spring and are not aimed at Munich or your positions. Keep A SIL and A PAR out of Belgium and Ruhr and we remain at peace.

I’ll keep French units out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel, and Irish Sea this spring. F POR will hold and A PAR will not enter Belgium. Please keep F NTH and F NWG off French centers, and keep F BER and A KIE away from my position. What are your orders for BER and KIE?

A SIL will leave BUD and SER untouched this spring. I need A VIE available to respond to Italy, so please keep A BUD and A SER out of French territory and avoid supporting attacks on my units. Can your armies hold rather than join the pressure on my central position?

I intend to keep F POR out of Italian centers, but A VIE must defend itself against your pressure. I will not attack Italian centers this spring if A MUN stays out of VIE and SIL and F MAR does not move against my French position. Where are A MUN and F MAR headed?

A MUN will stay clear of BUD and SER; my immediate pressure remains toward France, not your centers. I may still move A VIE to SER, as raised earlier, so please tell me whether A SER will hold or move against Turkey. Keep A BUD out of SER and we can avoid a clash.

I will keep A MUN out of VIE and SIL this spring, and I have no intention of moving against Italian centers. F MAR will not attack a French center this turn; I’m willing to limit the pressure to the front line, provided you keep clear of Italian centers.

F CON will stay put, and I will not attack GRE or a Turkish-held center this spring. I propose F ADR and F ION also remain clear of Turkish centers; keep A GRE and A BUL out of Italian territory, including SER, and we can avoid widening the conflict.

Russia to France, Spring 1914: A War and A Mos will hold this spring, and F Sev will not support anyone against you. Keep A Sil out of Warsaw and Ukraine as agreed. If Italy pressures Vienna, I would rather we both keep the central front quiet while I watch Galicia. Tell me if your Vienna plans change.

A ARM will not move to SEV, and F BLA will stay clear of RUM this spring. I’m turning south to deal with the Italian pressure. Can you confirm F RUM and F SEV will stay out of the Balkans, and A WAR will avoid SER?

I’m willing to discuss coordination against Italy, but need a concrete commitment. Will A SER and A BUD support each other defensively and stay clear of Turkish centers? I’m not promising to leave SER undefended or cede it while Italy threatens from CON and VIE.

I will keep A GRE clear of Italian centers, but I cannot promise A BUL stays out of SER while Austria remains an enemy. I expect F CON to stay out of GRE and other Turkish centers; I’ll keep my fleets clear of ION and ADR this spring if you do.

Italy and France now threaten my remaining centers, so I cannot afford another fight over SER. Please keep A BUL and A GRE out of SER this fall. I will keep A BUD and A SER in place and will not move against Turkish centers; let's contain Italy instead.

France has A BOH and A TRI beside my last centers, while Turkey can still press SER. Please keep your units out of BUD and SER this fall and use A MUN or another unit against France. I will not interfere with your centers.

Your A BOH and A TRI threaten both of my remaining centers. Please hold both clear of BUD and SER this fall; I need to defend against Turkey and Italy. I will keep my units out of French territory and will not support attacks on you.

England to France, Fall 1914: Your A PAR and A BOH sit near my Belgium and Ruhr. Germany is gone, so the open question is Munich and Burgundy. I will not enter Belgium or Holland while you stay out of them. Tell me exactly where A PAR, A BOH and F MAO go this fall.

Your A MUN can attack my A TRI, and F GOL can threaten my western centers. I propose keeping this to a front-line standstill: keep A MUN out of TRI and F GOL out of MAR; I will not move A TRI against Italian centers this fall. What are your orders?

I will keep my units out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Please keep F NTH and F NWG off French centers and keep F BER and A KIE away from my position. With Germany empty, are BER and KIE holding this fall?

I have A TRI and A BOH exposed to Italy. I will leave BUD and SER untouched; please keep A BUD and A SER out of French territory and avoid supporting Italian attacks on my units. What are your plans for your armies this fall?

This fall I intend to press your southern front from F GOL and A MUN. Please tell me whether F MAO will support F MAR and where A BOH is headed. I’ll keep my units out of your other centers; let’s avoid a wider war.

My F ION and F CON will stay clear of Turkish centers this fall. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of Italian centers, including ALB and SER, and keep F WES clear of ION. Are you planning to press SER or BUD?

Turkey remains a threat to your BUD and SER. What are your plans for A SER and A BUD this fall? I’m not planning to move into your centers; if you can spare support, please consider how we can contain Turkey without opening another front.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1914: Your fleets have pushed hard against Italy. I will keep F Rum, F Sev and A War out of the Balkans and away from your Bulgaria and Greece this fall. In return, I need A Bul and F Bla to stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol. Confirm that, and tell me whether A Ank or A Arm will threaten my Caucasus.

Russia to Italy, Fall 1914: Your fleets in the Ionian and Adriatic are a real threat to Turkey, and I am glad to see it. I hold Warsaw and Moscow defensively. Tell me whether A Mun and F Pie are aimed at France or Austria, and confirm that your forces will not move toward Galicia or Rumania.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1914: Your position in Bud and Ser is narrow. I have no quarrel with you while Italy and Turkey press. I will not move against Galicia this fall. Tell me whether your A Bud and A Ser will hold, or whether you plan to strike toward Rumania or Serbia, so we can avoid misunderstandings.

France has A TRI and A BOH pressing your position. Will A BUD support A SER against A TRI this fall, and can we coordinate to contain France? I still intend to contest SER, so please tell me whether you plan to hold it or move.

With F CON and F ION near my centers, I need a clear commitment: keep both fleets out of GRE, BUL, and SMY this fall, and I’ll keep A GRE and my fleets clear of Italian centers. What are your orders for F CON and F ION?
I’m focused on the southern front. Please keep F RUM, F SEV, and A WAR out of the Balkans this fall; I’ll keep F BLA clear of RUM and SEV. Are you holding those units?
A BUD will support A SER holding, and A SER will hold. I have no plans to move against RUM; please keep GAL clear and consider helping contain the Italian and Turkish pressure.
A BUD will support A SER holding; A SER will hold. I will keep both armies out of French territory and will not support attacks on your units. Please keep A BOH and A TRI out of BUD and SER.

A BUD will support A SER holding and A SER will hold. I will not move against Turkish centers, but I cannot coordinate against France while you still intend to contest SER. Keep A BUL and A GRE out of SER if you want cooperation.

A SER will hold, supported by A BUD. I will not move against your centers or support attacks on France. Please keep A VIE and your other units clear of BUD and SER, and use your forces to contain Turkey or France instead.

England to France, Fall 1914: Confirmed, F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers while your units stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. F BER and A KIE are holding this fall and are not aimed at you. Note Germany is empty, so Munich is the real prize; I will not enter Burgundy or Ruhr. Keep A PAR and A BOH out of Belgium and Ruhr, and we remain at peace.

A PAR will move to BUR, A BOH will hold, and F MAO will hold. I will stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Please keep F NTH and F NWG clear of French centers and keep F BER and A KIE away from my position; are BER and KIE holding?
A BOH and A TRI will hold clear of BUD and SER this fall. Please keep A BUD and A SER out of French territory and do not support Italian attacks on my units. What are your orders for BUD and SER?

F MAO will not support F MAR; it will hold, and A BOH will hold. I will keep A TRI out of Italian centers if A MUN stays out of TRI and F GOL stays out of MAR. Please confirm your exact orders for MUN and GOL.

A MUN and F PIE are focused west against France, not Austria. I will not move toward GAL or RUM this fall. My fleets remain a useful check on Turkey; are you planning to contest its position in BUL or SER?

I will keep my units out of BUD and SER this fall and use A MUN against France. Your A SER should defend against Turkey; I cannot spare support from my western front, but will avoid opening another front against you.

I intend to move A MUN against A TRI and F GOL against MAR; I will not accept a front-line standstill. I don't know whether F MAO will support F MAR or where A BOH is headed, so please keep A TRI out of Italian centers.

F CON and F ION will stay out of GRE, BUL, and SMY this fall. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of Italian centers, including ALB, and F WES clear of ION. I expect you may press SER, but I will not move against your centers.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1914: Agreed. F Rum, F Sev and A War will not enter the Balkans or move against your Bulgaria and Greece this fall. In return, A Bul and F Bla must stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol. Please confirm in writing. Also, A Ank and A Arm: if either moves toward the Caucasus, I will read it as hostile, so keep them defensive.
Confirmed: A BUL and F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV this fall. A ANK and A BUL are not heading toward the Caucasus; my immediate focus is the Italian front.
I will not move A BUL or A GRE into SER this fall. Keep A BUD supporting A SER against A TRI, and hold both centers; we can contain France and Italy without opening another front.
I will keep A GRE and A BUL out of Italian centers, including ALB and SER, and F WES clear of ION. I’m not pressing SER or BUD this fall. Keep F CON and F ION clear of Turkish centers as promised.

Our shared interest is preventing Italy from gaining further in the Balkans. Please keep A BUL and A GRE out of SER this spring; I will keep A BUD and A SER clear of Turkish centers. Can you confirm you will leave SER alone?
Your A TRI can reach BUD, and I cannot survive another front. Please keep A TRI and A TYR clear of BUD and SER this spring. I will not move against French centers; can we maintain that standstill?

I have only BUD and SER left and need to avoid a fight on another front. Please keep F ADR and A MUN clear of both this spring, and use your forces against France or Turkey. I will keep A BUD and A SER out of your centers.

England to France, Spring 1915: Your A BRE just built and A PAR sit close to my Belgium and Channel. I will keep F NTH and F NWG off French centers while no French unit enters Belgium, Holland, the Channel or Irish Sea. Tell me exactly where A PAR, A TYR and F NAF go this spring so we avoid misunderstanding.

England to Italy, Spring 1915: Your F TYS, F TUN and A MUN are pressing France and Austria. I will keep my fleets in the North Sea and Channel. Please confirm in writing that no Italian unit enters Marseille, Spain or Portugal's neighbourhood against England, and tell me your spring moves for MUN and TYS.

England to Russia, Spring 1915: Germany is empty, so the north is still quiet between us. My F SWE and A KIE are not aimed at Russia. Keep A MOS and A WAR away from Prussia and Galicia, and I will not move toward St. Petersburg or Norway. Tell me your spring plans for Turkey and Austria.

Your F GOL can take MAR and A MUN can attack TRI, so I need clarity before orders. I propose a one-turn standstill: keep F GOL out of MAR and A MUN out of TRI; I will keep A TRI out of Italian centers. Are you willing to agree?

Can we keep our western front quiet this turn? I will keep A PAR and the French fleets away from Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Please keep F NTH and F NWG clear of French centers, and tell me whether F BER and A KIE are still holding.
Italy is pressing my A TRI from MUN and F GOL threatens MAR. Please keep A BUD and A SER out of French territory and do not support Italian attacks on A TRI. What are your armies doing this spring?
Your A TRI and A TYR threaten my northern centers, while my A MUN and F GOL can pressure TRI and MAR. Keep A TRI out of VEN and I’ll keep F GOL out of MAR this spring; where are your armies moving?

France is exposed along its southern edge: I can pressure MAR from F GOL and TRI from A MUN. Are you planning to attack France from the north this spring? Coordination could prevent France from concentrating against either of us.

I’m positioned to contain Turkey from F ADR and F AEG. Are you planning to attack Turkey in BUL or elsewhere this spring? If so, I can consider pressure from the south, provided we coordinate and avoid conflicting moves.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1915: Your fleets pressed Italy and I kept F Rum, F Sev and A War out of the Balkans as promised. Confirm A Bul and F Bla stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this spring, and that A Ank and A Arm keep away from the Caucasus. Tell me if your plans toward Greece or Serbia change.
