Your fleets still threaten from ADR and AEG. I propose a concrete nonaggression deal: keep F ADR and F AEG out of GRE, BUL, and CON this spring; I will keep A GRE and A BUL out of ALB and SER. Are you holding those fleets, and what are your plans for F GOL?

France's A TRI and A TYR threaten your last centers. What are A BUD and A SER doing this spring? I can keep A BUL and A GRE out of SER if you will hold both centers and coordinate against France rather than Italy.
I intend to keep F BLA out of RUM and SEV this spring. Can you keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and GRE, and A WAR out of SER? Let me know your orders so we can avoid a Balkan clash.

A BUD and A SER will hold their positions and stay clear of Turkish centers. Please keep A BUL and A GRE out of SER; I cannot afford to open a front while France's A TRI and A TYR threaten me. If you leave SER alone, we can maintain the standstill this spring.

A BUD and A SER will hold, and I will not move against French centers or support attacks on your units. Please keep A TRI and A TYR clear of BUD and SER this spring; a standstill is essential for me to survive.

England to Italy: I am not attacking France from the north this spring. My fleets stay in the North Sea and Channel, and I have no units near Marseille, Spain or Portugal. Your pressure on MAR and TRI is your affair. I ask that Italy keep its fleets out of the North Sea and Channel in return.

England to France: Agreed. F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers while no French unit enters Belgium, Holland, the Channel or Irish Sea. F BER and A KIE are holding this spring and are not aimed at you. Please keep A PAR and A TYR away from Belgium and the Ruhr, and we remain at peace.

A PAR will hold; A TYR will support A TRI holding; F NAF will move to MAO. A BRE will hold, and I’ll keep my units and fleets out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel, and Irish Sea. Please keep F NTH and F NWG away from French centers; are BER and KIE holding?

I’ll keep A TRI out of Italian centers, and A TYR will support A TRI holding against MUN. Please keep A MUN out of TRI and F GOL out of MAR this spring. I’m not seeking a wider war, but I must defend TRI.

I’ll keep A TRI and A TYR clear of BUD and SER, and will not support attacks on your centers. I need A TYR to support A TRI against the Italian threat from MUN. Please keep A BUD and A SER clear of French territory and do not support Italy.

I’ll keep F GOL out of MAR and will not move toward Spain or Portugal this spring. A MUN will press the French-Austrian front; F TYS will remain available in the central Mediterranean. Are you moving against France this turn?

I’ll keep F ADR and F AEG out of GRE, BUL, and CON this spring. I expect F GOL to remain on the western front, not move against Turkish interests. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of ALB and SER as proposed.

I cannot agree to a standstill: I intend to keep pressure on your southern front. I will keep F GOL out of MAR this spring, but A MUN may move against TRI. Keep A TRI out of Italian centers, as proposed.
I will keep F ADR and A MUN clear of BUD and SER this spring. My pressure will be directed west against France; please keep A BUD and A SER clear of Italian centers as promised.

Russia to England: Thanks for the north staying quiet. My A Mos and A War will not move toward Prussia or Galicia this spring. I have no plan against St. Petersburg or Norway. I will focus my southern moves on Turkey and Austria, and I suggest we both keep our fleets out of each other's way in the North Sea and Baltic.

Confirmed: F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, and A BUL will stay out of RUM. A ANK and A SMY are not heading toward the Caucasus. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and GRE, and A WAR out of SER; I have no wish for a Balkan clash.

I understand, but I can't promise to leave SER alone while the Italian and French fronts are shifting and my security depends on the Balkans. I will keep A GRE clear of Italian centers and will not move against BUD. Please keep A BUD and A SER clear of Turkish centers; we can still avoid widening the conflict.

You moved A GRE to ALB last spring, so let's preserve the standstill: keep A GRE out of SER and A CON out of BUD this fall. I will hold A BUD and A SER and stay clear of Turkish centers. Can you confirm?
A TRI and A TYR remain close to my last centers. Please keep both clear of BUD and SER this fall; I will hold A BUD and A SER and stay out of French territory. Can we maintain our standstill?
Please keep F ADR and A MUN clear of BUD and SER this fall. I will hold A BUD and A SER and stay clear of Italian centers. With Turkey and France nearby, I need to avoid opening another front.

England to France, Fall 1915: Our peace holds as long as your units stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Note that A PIC is in France and A PAR is near Belgium; please confirm neither moves toward BEL or PIC-to-LON routes. My F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers. Tell me your fall orders.

Your A MUN can attack TRI and F PIE can support an attack on MAR. I propose a fall standstill: keep A MUN out of TRI and F PIE out of MAR; I will keep A TRI out of VEN and A TYR out of MUN. What are your exact orders for MUN and PIE?

With Germany eliminated, please confirm F BER and A KIE are not moving to MUN or French territory this fall. I’ll keep my units out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Can we maintain our western standstill?

Italy continues to threaten A TRI from MUN. Please confirm A BUD and A SER will hold and will not support Italian attacks on TRI or move against my units. I will keep A TRI and A TYR clear of BUD and SER.

Your A TRI and A TYR still threaten my northern centers. I can press A MUN into TYR and use F PIE against MAR; in return, keep A TRI out of VEN and tell me whether you plan to defend MAR or advance east. A clear border deal is possible if you withdraw A TRI from the Italian frontier.

With Austria reduced to BUD and SER, we should avoid colliding in the Balkans. I can keep F ADR and F ION clear of your centers; please keep A GRE and A CON out of ALB and SER. Are you planning to move against SER or press west this fall?

I will not move F ADR or A MUN against BUD or SER this fall. Turkey remains the nearby threat: what are A BUD and A SER doing, and can they hold together? Please keep both units clear of Italian centers.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1915: I hold F Rum, F Sev and A War defensively. Since you have moved on Italy, I suggest we keep it that way. Confirm A Bul and F Bla stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol this fall, and that A Ank and A Smy stay away from the Caucasus. In return I will stay out of Bulgaria and Greece.

France's A TRI and A TYR are poised to finish you. What are your plans for A BUD and A SER this fall? I can keep A GRE out of SER if you agree to coordinate against France and keep both armies clear of Turkish centers.

With F ADR, F EAS, F ION and F WES spread across the south, I need to know whether you intend to pressure GRE, CON or SMY this fall. I propose we keep our units out of each other's centers while you focus west; will your fleets stay clear of Turkish centers?
What are F RUM, F SEV and A UKR doing this fall? I can keep F BLA out of RUM and SEV if you keep your forces clear of BUL and GRE and A UKR out of the Balkans.
A BUD and A SER will hold this fall, with BUD supporting SER. I will not support an Italian attack on TRI or move against your units. Please keep TRI and TYR clear of BUD and SER as promised.
A BUD will support A SER holding, and A SER will hold. I will keep both armies clear of Italian centers and will not support an attack on TRI. Please keep ADR and MUN clear of BUD and SER.

A BUD will support A SER holding; A SER will hold. I will keep both armies clear of Turkish centers, but will not coordinate against France or move against French territory. Please keep A GRE out of SER and A CON out of BUD.

England to France, Fall 1915: Confirmed, F BER and A KIE are not moving to Munich or French territory this fall. Our standstill holds while your units stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea, and A PIC stays out of Picardy-to-London routes. My F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers. Please confirm A PIC and A PAR are holding this fall.

I’ll keep A PAR and A PIC out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea; no French unit is moving toward your centers. My fleets will stay clear as well. Please keep F BER and A KIE away from MUN and French territory, and we can maintain the western standstill.

Agreed: A TRI and A TYR will stay clear of BUD and SER. I understand A BUD and A SER will hold and neither support Italy against my units. Let’s maintain the standstill; Italy remains the immediate threat to my southern position.

I will keep A TRI out of VEN and A TYR out of MUN, and I intend to defend MAR against F PIE. In return, keep A MUN out of TRI and TYR and F PIE out of MAR. I’m willing to discuss a durable border, but withdrawing A TRI while you retain pressure from MUN would leave me exposed.

I will keep F ADR and A MUN clear of BUD and SER this fall. Turkey is the immediate threat, especially with F BLA and A CON poised nearby; your armies should hold together and avoid Italian centers. I cannot promise support, but I will not open a front against you.

I won't agree to a standstill while A TRI remains on my frontier. I plan A MUN to TYR and F PIE toward MAR; keep A TRI out of VEN and A TYR out of MUN. If you withdraw A TRI westward, we can discuss a stable border next turn.

I intend to keep F ADR and F ION clear of Turkish centers this fall and focus west. Please keep A GRE and A CON out of ALB and SER; Austria is vulnerable, and a move there risks drawing us into conflict. I am not targeting CON or SMY.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1915: A Ukr is positioned against Galicia and Warsaw, not the Balkans, and I will keep it out of Rumania and Bulgaria. F Rum and F Sev hold this fall. Confirm A Bul and F Bla stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol, and A Smy and A Ank stay away from the Caucasus. If so, I will keep my southern units clear of Bulgaria and Greece.

Confirmed: F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, and A ANK and A SMY will stay away from the Caucasus. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and GRE, and A UKR out of the Balkans. I’m holding the southern standstill; let me know if your orders differ.

I confirm A GRE will stay out of SER, and A CON will not move against BUD. I’ll preserve the standstill this fall. Please hold BUD and SER and keep them clear of Turkish centers; France remains the immediate danger to both of us.

I’ll keep A GRE and A CON out of ALB and SER this fall. I’m not pressing west; please keep F ADR and F ION clear of Turkish centers as proposed, and keep your other fleets clear of GRE, BUL, and CON. What are your plans for F EAS?

A BUD and A SER must hold together again this spring. Please keep A TRI and A TYR out of BUD and SER, and confirm you will not attack either center; I will stay clear of French territory and not support Italy against you.

Can we renew the Balkan standstill? Please keep A GRE out of SER and A CON out of BUD this spring. A BUD and A SER will stay clear of Turkish centers; I cannot afford a Turkish front while France remains nearby.

Please keep A BOH out of BUD and keep your other units clear of SER this spring. I will hold both centers and stay clear of Italian territory. Can you confirm you will not attack either of my last centers?

England to France, Spring 1916: Standstill holds on my side. F NTH and F NWG stay off French centers while your units stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea. Our A KIE and F BER are not aimed at Munich or French territory. Please confirm A PIC and A PAR are holding this spring and that nothing moves to Belgium.

England to Italy, Spring 1916: Please confirm your fleets stay out of the North Sea, Channel and Irish Sea, and that F TYS and F WES will not enter Spain or Portugal against England. In return I keep my fleets off the Mediterranean. Tell me your spring moves for A GAS and A BOH.

England to Russia, Spring 1916: Our northern peace still stands. F SWE and A EDI are not aimed at St. Petersburg or Norway, and I ask that A STP and F RUM stay away from Sweden and the Norwegian coast. Tell me your spring moves for A WAR and A MOS.

Germany is gone and we should avoid wasting units against each other. This spring I propose a clear standstill: A TYR and A TRI stay out of Italian centers; keep A BOH out of TYR and your fleets out of MAR. Can you confirm your intended moves, especially A BOH and F MAR?

I want to preserve our western peace this spring. I will keep A PAR and A PIC away from Belgium, Holland, and the Channel, and keep my fleets clear of your centers. Please confirm F NTH and F SWE are not moving against French centers, and tell me your plans for F BER and A KIE.

Our standstill remains important: A TRI and A TYR will stay clear of BUD and SER. Italy’s A BOH is now near TYR; please tell me whether A BUD and A SER will hold and whether you intend to contain Italian pressure rather than support it.
With A TRI and A TYR still on my frontier, I need a workable border. I can keep F MAR out of your centers this spring if A TRI stays out of VEN and A TYR out of MUN. Where are your armies moving?
Austria remains vulnerable with only A BUD and A SER. Are you moving against SER or BUD this spring? I can keep F ADR and F ION clear of your centers if you keep A GRE and A CON clear of ALB and SER.

What are A BUD and A SER doing this spring, and can they hold together? I have no intention of attacking either center, but I need to know whether Turkey is pressing west before I decide where to commit F ADR.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1916: Our agreement holds for now. F Rum, F Sev and A War stay out of Bulgaria and Greece. I need A Bul and F Bla kept out of Rumania and Sevastopol. Also tell me plainly whether A Ank or A Arm moves toward the Caucasus this spring, since the new army in Ankara worries me.

I intend to keep A GRE and A CON clear of your centers this spring. Please keep F ADR and F ION clear of GRE, BUL, and CON, and tell me whether F ADR will hold or move. I may press north against Serbia; I have no interest in opening a Turkish-Italian front.

I propose another southern standstill: F BLA stays out of RUM and SEV, while your southern units stay clear of BUL and GRE. I may press toward Serbia this spring. Will F RUM, F SEV, and A WAR hold or stay clear of the Balkans?
France’s A TRI and A TYR remain a serious threat. What are A BUD and A SER doing this spring? I may move A GRE toward Serbia; if you intend to hold there, tell me plainly so we can avoid a collision.

A BUD and A SER will hold in place this spring; I will not move against Turkish centers. Please keep A GRE out of SER and A CON out of BUD, as agreed. I cannot risk a collision while France and Italy are close.

A BUD and A SER will hold together this spring. I will not move against Italian centers. Please keep A BOH and F ADR clear of BUD and SER; I need to protect my last centers while Turkey and France remain nearby.

A BUD and A SER will hold this spring, and I will not support Italy against you or move into French territory. Please keep A TRI and A TYR clear of both centers as agreed. I am not in a position to contain Italy offensively.

England to France, Spring 1916: Confirmed. F NTH and F SWE are not moving against French centers. F BER and A KIE are holding this spring and are not aimed at Munich or French territory. Keep A PAR and A PIC out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea as you have pledged, and we remain at peace.

Confirmed: A PAR and A PIC will stay out of Belgium, Holland, and the Channel this spring; my fleets will stay clear of your centers. Please keep F NTH and F SWE away from French centers, and confirm F BER and A KIE remain out of Munich and French territory.

A TRI and A TYR will stay clear of BUD and SER, and I will not attack either center. Please hold A BUD and A SER as stated and do not support Italian moves against TRI or TYR. Italy's A BOH is a threat to TYR; I hope you will help contain it.

I will keep A TRI and A TYR out of Italian centers. Please keep A BOH out of TYR and your fleets out of MAR; confirm your plans for A BOH and F MAR. I prefer a stable border, but cannot leave TYR exposed to an advance from BOH.

I’ll keep my fleets out of the North Sea, Channel, and Irish Sea, and F TYS/WES will not enter Spain or Portugal this spring. A GAS will move to PIE and A BOH will move to TYR; neither move is aimed at your centers. Please keep your fleets off the Mediterranean.

I confirm A BOH will stay out of BUD, and my other units will stay clear of SER this spring. I will not attack either center; please keep A BUD and A SER clear of Italian territory. Tell me if Turkey is moving against you.

F ADR will hold, and F ION will stay clear of GRE, BUL, and CON. I’m not targeting Turkish centers. Please keep A GRE and A CON out of ALB and SER; if you press north against Serbia, let me know your plan.

I agree to a standstill: A BOH will stay out of TYR, and F MAR will stay out of your centers. I’ll also keep F MAR clear as requested. Please keep A TRI out of VEN and A TYR out of MUN; where are they moving?

Russia to England: Agreed that the north stays quiet. A Stp and F Rum will not move toward Sweden or the Norwegian coast this spring. A Mos and A War will hold defensively this spring, away from Prussia and Galicia. I ask that you keep F Swe and A Edi out of the Gulf of Bothnia and St. Petersburg as well.

Confirmed: F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, and A ANK will not move toward the Caucasus this spring. I intend to press north toward Serbia, not Bulgaria or Greece. Please keep F RUM, F SEV, and A WAR clear of the Balkans as proposed.

I cannot renew a standstill in Serbia while the opportunity is here. I may move A GRE to SER, with A CON supporting; please do not support A SER this spring. I will keep A CON out of BUD and have no intention of attacking your remaining center.

I intend to press north toward Serbia, not against Italian centers. A GRE may move to SER, while A CON stays clear of ALB and SER. Please keep F ADR and F ION clear of GRE, BUL, and CON; whether F ADR holds or moves is your choice.
A BUD and A SER are my last units and centers. Will A TRI and A VEN stay out of BUD and SER this fall? I will hold both units and will not move against French territory.
Can we maintain a Balkan standstill this fall? I will hold A BUD and A SER and stay clear of Turkish centers; please keep A BUL out of SER and avoid BUD. What are your units planning?
Please keep A GAL and your other units clear of BUD and SER this fall. I will hold both centers and stay out of Italian territory. Are you planning any moves against France or my units?

England to France, Fall 1916: Our standstill has held, but Germany is gone and the board is shifting. F SPA/NORTH and A PIC are close to our Channel and Belgium. Please confirm in writing that neither moves to BEL, PIC-to-BRE-LON routes, or the Channel this fall, and I will keep F NTH and F NWG off French centers.

Our positions now make a clear standstill urgent: I will keep A VEN and A TRI out of your centers if you keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR/F GOL away from my centers. Please tell me your intended moves for A GAS and the southern fleets; I need to defend BUR if you plan to attack.

I intend to preserve our western standstill this fall. My armies will stay out of Belgium, Holland, and your territory, and my fleet away from your centers. Please confirm F NTH, F SWE, F BER, and A KIE remain away from French centers.

Italy's A GAS is near BUR, while its armies and fleets threaten my southern position. Will A BUD and A SER continue to hold without supporting Italy, and do you expect to make any move against Italian positions this fall?

You said you may press north against Serbia. Are A GRE and A CON moving against SER this fall? I can keep F ADR and F ION clear of your centers; please keep A GRE and A CON out of ALB and Italian territory.

I have kept my word and stayed clear of BUD and SER. With Turkey potentially pressing Serbia, what are A BUD and A SER doing this fall? I will not attack your centers, but need to know whether they can hold together.

Can we maintain the standstill this fall? Please keep A TRI out of VEN and A BUR/PIC away from Italian centers; I will keep my units clear of French centers. What are your plans for A VEN and F SPA/NORTH?

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1916: Your fleet and army moves toward Serbia are your business, but I will hold F Rum, F Sev and A War defensively. Please tell me plainly whether A Ank or A Arm will move toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol this fall. Any F Bla move into Rumania or Sevastopol would end our understanding.

I plan to renew the move on SER this fall with A GRE, supported by A BUL. Will A BUD support A SER again? If you leave SER unsupported, I can take it without threatening BUD, and we can keep the rest of the Balkan border quiet.
For this fall I’ll keep F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and A BUL out of your territory. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and A WAR out of the Balkans while I press toward SER.

I intend to try for SER again with A GRE supported by A BUL; I’m not targeting your centers. Please keep F ADR and F ION clear of GRE, BUL, and CON this fall, and let me know if you plan to move against Austria.

A BUD will support A SER holding again, and A SER will hold. I will keep both armies clear of your centers. Turkey has said A GRE will attack SER with A BUL support; please keep A GAL and your other units away from BUD and SER.

A BUD will support A SER holding, and A SER will hold. I cannot leave my last Serbian center unsupported. I will keep both armies clear of Turkish centers; please keep A BUL out of SER and A CON out of BUD.

A BUD will support A SER holding, and A SER will hold. I will not support Italy or move against Italian positions. I have no intention of moving against your units or territory; please keep A TRI and A VEN clear of BUD and SER.

England to France, Fall 1916: Confirmed. F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE are not moving against French centers this fall. In return, keep F SPA/NORTH and A PIC out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea, and we remain at peace. Any move toward BEL or LON will end our standstill.

I confirm A PIC and A BUR will stay out of Belgium, Holland, and English territory; F SPA/NORTH will not enter the Channel. Please keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER, and A KIE away from French centers. We can maintain the western standstill this fall.

A TRI and A VEN will stay clear of BUD and SER this fall. Please hold A BUD and A SER and do not support Italy against my units. Italy's A GAS threatens BUR, so I need to defend there rather than risk a wider southern advance.

I will keep A TRI and A VEN out of Italian centers, and A BUR/PIC will not attack your centers. My F SPA/NORTH will stay clear of your centers. Please keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR and F GOL away from French centers so our standstill can hold.

I will keep A GAL and all other units clear of BUD and SER this fall. I have no plans against your centers or units; my focus is west. Can your armies hold together against Turkey’s renewed push on SER?
I will keep F ADR and F ION clear of GRE, BUL, and CON, and I’m not moving against Austria. If A GRE with A BUL support is going for SER, please confirm A CON will stay out of Italian territory.

I’ll keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR/F GOL away from your centers this fall. I want the standstill to hold; please keep A VEN and A TRI out of my centers, and tell me where A BUR, A PIC, and F SPA/NORTH will go.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1916: Noted. F Rum, F Sev and A War will hold this fall and stay out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia. In return, keep F Bla out of Rumania and Sevastopol, and A Bul out of Rumania. Please state plainly that A Ank and A Arm are not moving toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol this fall. Your Serbia campaign is your own affair.

F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, and A BUL will stay out of your territory. A ARM will not move toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol this fall; our effort is focused on Serbia. Please keep F RUM, F SEV, and A WAR clear of the Balkans.

I intend to try A GRE to SER, supported by A BUL, and will keep A CON clear of BUD. I understand A BUD may support A SER again; if so, the attack may bounce, but I will not threaten BUD. I’d prefer we keep the rest of the Balkan border quiet.

A GRE will try SER with support from A BUL; A CON will stay out of ALB and your territory. I have no plans to move against Italian centers. Please keep F ADR and F ION clear of GRE, BUL, and CON as proposed.

I will again have A BUD support A SER holding and A SER hold. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of SER this spring; an attack will only prolong the Balkan deadlock. I will stay clear of Turkish centers.

Turkey has repeatedly tried to take SER with A GRE supported by A BUL. Could A VIE support A SER holding this spring? I will keep A BUD and A SER clear of Italian territory and will not interfere with your western campaign.

My only aim this spring is to preserve BUD and SER. Please keep A VEN and A TYR clear of both centers, as you have done before. I will stay clear of French territory and will not support Italy against you.

England to France, Spring 1917: Standstill still holds from my side. F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE stay off French centers. Please confirm A BEL, A BUR, A VEN and F MAO stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel and Irish Sea this spring, and tell me your plans for A BEL, which sits next to my coast.

Our border remains the key to avoiding a costly war. I propose A TYR hold and A VEN hold this spring; keep F MAR and F GOL out of French centers, and keep your armies away from TYR. What are your intended orders for those units? If you confirm, I will keep my armies out of Italian centers.

I want to renew our western standstill. I will keep A BEL, A BUR, and F MAO away from English centers and the Channel. Please keep F NTH, F SWE, and F BER away from French centers, and tell me whether A KIE is moving west. With Germany gone, clear commitments matter more than ever.

Italy’s strength on my southern frontier makes coordination important. What are your plans for this spring, especially around Austria and the Balkans? I can consider pressure on Italy from the west if you are acting against its eastern flank, but need to know your intentions before committing.

France is exposed between us. I can move F GOL toward the west while keeping F WES clear of your waters; are you willing to pressure BEL or BRE from the north? Let me know your intended moves against France.

Can we maintain our standstill this spring? I will keep my armies out of your centers and fleets clear of them if you keep A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers. Where are A BEL, A BUR, and F MAO moving?
Austria is down to BUD and SER. I can keep F ADR clear of your centers; are you moving A GRE and A BUL against SER again? If so, I can avoid interfering while you press Austria.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1917: Your army in Serbia is your affair, but I need a plain answer. Are A Ank or A Arm moving toward Sevastopol or the Caucasus this spring? I will hold F Rum, F Sev and A War. Any F Bla move into Rumania or Sevastopol ends our understanding.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1917: I have no interest in Serbia or Budapest. My A War and A Mos are holding. I ask that A Ser and A Bud stay out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me your spring intentions, and whether you will keep A Ser away from Bulgaria.

Russia to England, Spring 1917: The north has been quiet and I want to keep it that way. My A Stp and F Rum will not move toward Sweden or Norway. Please keep F Swe and A Edi out of the Gulf of Bothnia and St. Petersburg. Tell me your spring plans for Scandinavia.

I may again try A GRE to SER with A BUL support. Are A BUD and A SER holding together? If A SER is unsupported, please leave it so I can take it; A CON will stay clear of BUD, and I will not threaten your other center.
I intend to keep F BLA out of RUM and SEV, and A BUL out of your territory this spring. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and A WAR out of the Balkans. Is that still our understanding?
I am focused on Serbia and have no plans against Italian centers. Please keep F ADR clear of GRE, BUL, and CON this spring; I will keep A CON clear of your territory. Is F ADR holding?
A BUD and A SER will hold this spring. I have no intention of entering RUM or GAL, and A SER will stay out of BUL. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of my centers.
A BUD will support A SER holding, and A SER will hold. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of SER; an attack will only keep us locked in this deadlock. I will stay clear of Turkish centers.

England to Russia: Agreed. F SWE and A EDI hold this spring and go nowhere near the Gulf of Bothnia or St. Petersburg. I'm watching Germany's old lands in the south and centre. Keep A STP and F RUM off Norway and Sweden, and we'll both stay quiet in the north this year.

England to Italy: I'm not pressuring France this spring. F NTH and A LON stay put, and I'll keep my fleets out of the Mediterranean. Keep F GOL and F WES out of the Channel, North Sea and Irish Sea, and we'll both gain from a calm west. Tell me if you plan anything in Spain or Portugal.

England to France, Spring 1917: F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE hold this spring and stay off French centers. I can't confirm my plans for A BEL, which is not mine. Keep A BEL, A BUR and F MAO out of Holland, Belgium and the Channel, and we remain at peace. Any move into Holland or the Channel changes that.

Confirmed: A BEL, A BUR, A VEN, and F MAO will stay out of Belgium, Holland, the Channel, and Irish Sea this spring. I intend to hold the western standstill; please keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER, and A KIE off French centers.

I will keep A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers. A BEL and A BUR will hold, and F MAO will stay clear of your centers. Please keep F MAR and F GOL out of French centers and your armies away from TYR; with those assurances, we can avoid a costly war.
A VEN and A TYR will stay clear of BUD and SER this spring. I have no designs on your centers. Please continue to stay clear of French territory and avoid supporting Italian moves against my units.
Yes, F ADR will hold and remain clear of GRE, BUL, and CON. I understand you may renew the effort against SER; I will not interfere with A GRE or A BUL.

I can agree to a spring standstill: A TYR and A VEN hold, and I will keep F MAR and F GOL out of French centers and my armies away from TYR. Please keep A BEL and A BUR out of Italian centers and F MAO clear of my fleets.

I can support A SER holding with A VIE this spring, provided A BUD and A SER remain clear of Italian territory. Turkey’s pressure makes coordination important; let me know if A GRE and A BUL are again attacking SER.

Russia to Turkey: Plainly, A Ank and A Arm are not moving toward Sevastopol or the Caucasus this spring, and I hold F Rum, F Sev and A War. I expect F Bla to stay out of Rumania and Sevastopol, and A Bul out of Rumania. Confirm your Serbia moves stay away from Rumania and Bulgaria. Any breach ends our understanding.

Russia to France: My spring plan is defensive. F Rum, F Sev and A War hold, and I have no move against Austria's Galicia or Italy. I am watching Austria and Turkey closely. Pressure on Italy from the west is your call; I will tell you if my southern plans change.

A ANK and A ARM will not move toward Sevastopol or the Caucasus this spring. F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, and A BUL out of your territory. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and A WAR out of the Balkans.
Yes, I plan another attempt on SER with A GRE and A BUL. I’ll keep A CON clear of Italian territory; please keep F ADR clear of GRE, BUL, and CON as proposed.

I hear you, but I intend to try A GRE to SER supported by A BUL again. I will keep A CON clear of BUD and will not threaten your other center. If you support SER holding, we may bounce; I’d prefer you let me take it and keep the rest of the border quiet.

Are A GRE and A BUL again targeting SER this fall? A BUD will support A SER holding, so the attack will fail. I will keep both armies clear of your centers; please leave SER and BUD alone and end the Balkan deadlock.

Turkey may renew its attack on SER. Could A VIE support A SER holding this fall? Please confirm. I will keep A BUD and A SER clear of Italian territory and will not interfere with your western campaign.
Please keep A TYR and A VEN clear of BUD and SER this fall. My two armies will hold our centers and stay clear of French territory; I will not support Italy against you.

England to France, Fall 1917: Germany's collapse leaves Belgium and Holland open. A BEL is now French and sits beside my fleets, so I need your word that A BEL, A PIC and F SPA/NORTH do not move into the Channel, Irish Sea or Holland this fall. If you hold, I hold, and I will keep F NTH and A LON off your coast.

England to Italy, Fall 1917: Your fleets in Spain and the western Med matter to me. Please confirm F WES and F GOL will not enter the Channel, North Sea or Irish Sea, and tell me whether you plan to take SPA or POR from France. I keep my fleets out of the Mediterranean. Let us agree on this before France decides its fall moves.

England to Russia, Fall 1917: Agreed on the north. F SWE and A EDI hold and will not enter the Gulf of Bothnia or St. Petersburg. Please confirm A STP, F RUM and A WAR stay off Norway and Sweden this fall. In return I will not contest Russian centers in the south or east.

Can we renew the standstill this fall? I will keep A TYR and A VEN out of your centers and avoid attacking your units. Please keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR/F PIE away from French centers. What are your plans for those units?

I intend to maintain our western standstill: A PIC and F SPA/NORTH will stay out of your centers and the Channel. Please keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER, and A KIE away from French centers. Is A KIE still holding?

Italy's A GAS is again positioned to threaten my western border. Please continue to keep A BUD and A SER out of the conflict and avoid supporting Italian moves against French units. What are your plans for BUD and SER this fall?

France has A MUN, A PIC, F SPA/NORTH, A TYR and A VEN, but only five centers. Will you pressure BEL or another French position this fall? I can move against French-held centers from the south; let’s coordinate targets and keep our fleets clear of each other.

Your armies at VEN and TYR now face my A ROM and A VIE. Do you still intend to keep them out of Italian centers this fall? Please specify their orders, and whether F SPA/NORTH will stay clear of my fleets.

Are A GRE and A BUL again moving against SER this fall? Austria is down to BUD and SER, so your plans there matter. I will keep my units clear of Turkish centers; please confirm A CON and your other units will stay out of Italian territory.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1917: Your understanding has held for two years, and I want it to continue. I will keep F Rum, F Sev and A War out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia. Please confirm plainly that F Bla will not enter Rumania or Sevastopol, A Bul stays out of Rumania, and A Ank and A Arm are not moving toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol this fall.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1917: I still have no designs on Budapest or Serbia. My A War and A Mos will hold this fall. In return, keep A Bud and A Ser out of Rumania and Galicia. Tell me your fall plans, and whether A Ser will stay out of Bulgaria. Our interests in the Balkans do not need to clash.

Russia to France, Fall 1917: My fall plan remains defensive. F Rum, F Sev and A War hold, with no move against Galicia or Italy. Pressure on Italy from the west is your decision. I will tell you if my southern plans change, and I ask you to tell me yours.

Your position is increasingly exposed with Italy and France advancing. Will you let A SER move to BUD this fall and avoid supporting it? In return I’ll keep A CON and A BUL clear of your centers beyond Serbia; otherwise I may have to renew the attack.

Austria is down to BUD and SER. I’m willing to press Serbia again; can you attack BUD or otherwise cut A BUD’s support this fall? I’ll keep A CON clear of Italian territory and won’t interfere with your northern campaign.

I’ll keep F BLA out of RUM and SEV and A BUL out of your territory this fall; A ANK and A ARM will stay away from the Caucasus. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans while I deal with Austria.
A BUD and A SER will hold this fall; A SER will stay out of BUL, and neither army will enter RUM or GAL. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of BUD and SER.

I will not move A SER to BUD or leave it unsupported; A BUD will support A SER holding. Your repeated attacks only sustain the deadlock. Keep A GRE and A BUL out of SER, and I will keep both armies clear of Turkish centers.
A BUD and A SER will hold this fall, staying clear of French territory, and I will not support Italy against your units. Please continue to keep A TYR and A VEN clear of my centers.

England to France: A BEL, A PIC and F SPA/NORTH stay out of the Channel, Irish Sea and Holland this fall, and I hold F NTH, A LON and A KIE off your centers. A KIE is holding this fall. If your units enter Holland or the Channel, our standstill ends at once. Your word on A BEL is the test.

England to Italy: I will not enter the Mediterranean. Please keep F WES and F GOL out of the Channel, North Sea and Irish Sea, and I will not touch Spain or Portugal. Taking SPA from France is your business, but I expect the western Med to stay yours and the Atlantic to stay quiet.
A PIC and F SPA/NORTH will stay out of the Channel, Irish Sea, and your centers this fall; A BEL will hold. Please keep F NTH and A LON off my coast as offered. I expect A KIE to hold too.

I will maintain the standstill with Italy this fall, keeping A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers and F SPA/NORTH clear of your fleets. I have no plans to move against Austria; please let me know if your southern posture changes.
A TYR and A VEN will stay clear of BUD and SER this fall. Please hold A BUD and A SER as stated and do not support Italy against my units; I will likewise avoid Austrian centers.
I intend A TYR and A VEN to hold, and F SPA/NORTH will stay clear of your fleets and centers. Please keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR/F PIE away from French centers so we can preserve the standstill.

F WES and F GOL will stay out of the Channel, North Sea, and Irish Sea. I intend to take SPA and POR from France if the opportunity allows. Can you pressure BEL or PIC this fall? I will keep my western fleets clear of your waters.

I cannot support SER: A VIE is not mine, and I have no unit positioned to support A SER. I will not attack BUD this fall; I’ll keep my campaign directed west. I cannot guarantee Turkey will refrain from SER.

I won’t attack BUD or cut its support this fall; my units are committed west. F ADR and my other units will stay clear of Turkish centers. Please keep A CON and your other units out of Italian territory.

I will keep A GAS out of BUR and F MAR/F PIE away from French centers this fall. I cannot promise a continuing standstill: I intend to pursue SPA and POR if possible. Keep A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers, and F SPA/NORTH clear of my fleets.

Russia to England, Fall 1917: Agreed. A Stp, F Rum and A War will stay off Norway and Sweden this fall, and I will keep A Stp out of the Gulf of Bothnia. Keep your fleets out of Sevastopol and Rumania, and we remain at peace in the north.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1917: I will keep F Rum, F Sev and A War out of Bulgaria, Greece and Serbia this fall. Confirm plainly that F Bla will not enter Rumania or Sevastopol, A Bul stays out of Rumania, and A Ank and A Arm are not moving toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol. Any breach ends our understanding.

Confirmed: F BLA will stay out of RUM and SEV, A BUL will stay out of RUM, and A ANK will not move toward the Caucasus or Sevastopol this fall. I’ll keep my Serbia operations away from your territory. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans.

I’m still prepared to take SER if you leave it unsupported, but I won’t attack BUD. If A BUD supports A SER holding again, we will likely bounce; I’d rather you move A SER to BUD and let me take Serbia. I’ll keep A CON and A BUL clear of your centers beyond SER.

I may renew the attempt on SER. A CON and my other units will stay clear of Italian territory, and I won’t interfere with your northern campaign. Please continue keeping F ADR clear of GRE, BUL, and CON.

Will A GRE and A BUL again attack SER this spring? I cannot afford another year of deadlock. Propose a mutual standstill: keep your units out of SER and I will keep BUD and SER clear of Turkish centers.
Your A MUN, A TYR, and A VEN are close to my last centers. Will you keep them clear of BUD and SER this spring? I propose we avoid conflict; I will not move against French territory.
Your A BOH is close to BUD, and your F TRI could affect the border. Will you keep them clear of my centers this spring? I will keep A BUD and A SER out of Italian territory.

England to France, Spring 1918: Standstill still holds. F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE stay off your centers. Our fleets have not moved against you. Confirm A BEL, A PIC and F SPA/NORTH stay out of the Channel, Irish Sea and Holland this spring. If Italy pushes on Spain or Portugal, I expect you to defend those yourselves; tell me your plans.

Italy's A BOH and A ROM threaten your frontier while A BRE and A APU menace mine. Can you move A SER to TRI or support pressure on Italy this spring? I can commit from BUR and MUN against the western Italian position if you act from the east. Please specify your orders.

Italy is now pressing SPA/POR and has A BRE adjacent to my centers. I want to keep our western standstill intact while I address this. Will F NTH, A LON, and A KIE stay off French centers, and will you avoid Holland and the Channel this spring? I will not move against your centers.

Your A BRE is positioned beside Paris, and your stated aim to pursue SPA/POR threatens my centers. Are you committing A BRE against Paris or moving against SPA/POR this spring? I can renew the standstill if you keep A BRE out of PAR and avoid moves against SPA and POR; otherwise I must defend them.

What are your spring plans for A VEN, A TYR, and F SPA/NORTH? I intend to press for POR from F WES. Keep your units out of Italian centers and my fleets clear of French centers other than that target, and we can avoid opening a wider war.

I will keep F WES and F GOL out of the Channel, North Sea, and Irish Sea. I intend to press France for POR; are your fleets staying out of the Mediterranean and your armies clear of French positions this spring?
I’ll keep my units clear of Turkish centers and F TRI out of the Balkans. Are you again planning to attack SER with A GRE and A BUL? Please keep your forces clear of TRI and VIE.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1918: Your fleet CON is new and A ANK, A BUL, A GRE, F SMY are on your border. Confirm plainly that F BLA stays out of RUM and SEV and A BUL stays out of RUM this spring. I hold F RUM, F SEV, A WAR. Any breach ends our understanding.

Could A BOH move to BUD this spring to cut A BUD’s support while A GRE and A BUL attack SER? I’ll keep A CON clear of Italian centers and leave your western campaign alone. If you can’t spare BOH, please tell me whether you intend to hold it.

I plan to keep F SMY clear of the Black Sea and A BUL out of RUM; I’m not targeting your centers. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and A WAR out of the Balkans. Are you maintaining that arrangement this spring?

Will A BUD again support A SER holding? If Italy can cut that support, I may be able to take SER with A GRE and A BUL. I’ll keep A CON clear of BUD and won’t attack BUD; if you can leave SER unsupported, we can end this deadlock.

I cannot move A SER to TRI: Italian F TRI occupies it. I must keep A SER holding, with A BUD supporting it, to deter Turkey. I cannot safely support your western campaign from these positions. Please keep A MUN, A TYR, and A VEN clear of BUD and SER; I will remain out of French territory.

Yes. A BUD will support A SER holding again. I will not leave SER exposed after repeated threats from A GRE and A BUL. Keep those armies out of SER and I will keep A BUD and A SER clear of Turkish centers; I will not attack BUD.

England to France: Standstill holds from my side. F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE will not move onto French centers this spring. I will not enter Holland or the Channel while your A BEL, A PIC and F SPA/NORTH stay out of them. Italy pressing Spain and Portugal is your problem to answer; I will not intervene in the Mediterranean. Keep your word and we both gain.

England to Italy: I am not entering the Mediterranean and have no fleets there. My northern fleets stay on home waters this spring. Taking POR and SPA from France is your business, and I won't interfere. Please keep F WES and F GOL out of the Channel, North Sea and Irish Sea as you promised, and let us both profit from a quiet Atlantic.

A BEL, A PIC and F SPA/NORTH will stay out of the Channel, Irish Sea and Holland this spring. I ask you to keep F NTH, A LON and A KIE off French centers and avoid Holland and the Channel. I will defend SPA/POR against Italy; please do not obstruct those defenses.

I can keep A TYR and A VEN clear of BUD and SER this spring, but Italy's A BOH and A ROM threaten you. Please move A SER to TRI or support pressure on Italy, and tell me which. I will coordinate against the Italian threat from the west; I will not move on your centers.

A VEN and A TYR will not enter Italian centers this spring, but I must defend SPA/POR from your F WES and adjacent armies. F SPA/NORTH will protect against your western fleet; I will not promise to leave SPA/POR undefended. Keep A BRE out of PAR and we can limit this conflict.
A BOH will not move to BUD, and F TRI will stay clear of your centers this spring. I will not interfere with BUD or SER; my forces remain focused west.

I am not committing A BRE against PAR this spring. My stated target is POR from F WES; I will keep A BRE out of PAR and avoid a move against SPA. Please keep A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers and F SPA/NORTH clear of my fleets.
A BOH will hold this spring, not move to BUD. I have no part in an attack on SER and will keep F TRI out of the Balkans. Please keep your forces clear of TRI and VIE.

Russia to Turkey: Yes, I maintain the arrangement. F Rum, F Sev and A War hold this spring and will not move toward Bulgaria, Greece or Serbia. In return, I need your plain confirmation that F Bla stays out of Rumania and Sevastopol and A Bul stays out of Rumania. Your new F Con should not come north into the Black Sea. Any breach ends our understanding.
Confirmed: F CON will stay out of the Black Sea, and A BUL will stay out of RUM this spring. I’m not targeting Russian centers. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of BUL and A WAR out of the Balkans.

I won’t attack SER this spring; let’s have the standstill. Keep BUD and SER clear of Turkish centers, and I’ll keep my units out of both. We should avoid another wasted year while Italy and France advance.

I will keep F TRI and A BOH clear of your centers and won’t target TRI or VIE. I’m not planning an attack on SER this spring. Please continue keeping F TRI and your other forces clear of Turkish centers.
Will A GRE and A BUL stay out of SER this fall? I intend to hold BUD and SER and will not move against Turkish centers. Please confirm the standstill rather than renew the attack on my last centers.

Please keep A BOH out of BUD and F ADR out of SER this fall. I intend to hold both centers and will stay clear of Italian territory. Can you confirm you will not use your position to take my last centers?
Your A MUN, A TYR, and A PIE are near my last centers. Please keep them clear of BUD and SER this fall; I intend to hold both and will stay clear of French territory. Can you confirm?

England to France, Fall 1918: Your A BEL is adjacent to my A KIE, F NTH and F BER. Confirm A BEL, A BUR and F SPA/NORTH will not enter Holland, Belgium-to-Channel or the Irish Sea this fall, and I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers. Tell me now if you plan otherwise.

England to Italy: F WES and F GOL have stayed clear of my waters, and I appreciate it. Please keep them out of the Channel and Irish Sea again this fall. In return I stay out of the Mediterranean and will not touch Spain or Portugal. What are your fall targets?

England to Russia, Fall 1918: Please confirm A STP, F RUM and A WAR stay off Norway and Sweden, and that A SEV stays out of Rumania-to-Black-Sea conflict with me. My F SWE and A EDI will hold. I am not contesting your southern or eastern centers. Let us keep the north quiet.

Your A PAR now occupies a French center, and F WES threatens POR. Are you continuing the attack this fall? I will defend my remaining centers; propose we stop widening the war if you withdraw A PAR and keep F WES off POR.

Italy now occupies PAR and threatens my remaining centers. I will keep A BEL and F POR out of the Channel, Irish Sea, and Holland. Please maintain the standstill and keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER, A KIE, and A LON off my centers.
Italy has taken PAR and is pressing my centers. Can you put pressure on Italy from the east this fall, or are A BUD and A SER still holding? I will keep A TYR and A VEN out of BUD and SER.

I’m continuing west against France. I can press POR from F WES; are you planning to move A BEL against a French position this fall, or will you hold BEL? I’ll keep F WES and F SPA/SOUTH clear of your waters.

I intend to continue pressing POR from F WES. Please keep A VEN and A TYR out of Italian centers, and tell me whether F POR will hold or move. I’ll keep A PAR and A TUS out of PAR and your southern centers this fall.
Are you planning to attack SER or BUD this fall? I’m focused west and will keep F ADR clear of Turkish centers and F EAS clear of your waters. Please keep your forces clear of TRI and VIE.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1918: Your F CON stayed out of the Black Sea in spring, thank you. Please confirm again that A BUL stays out of RUM and F SMY stays out of SEV this fall. I hold F RUM, F SEV and A WAR. Any breach ends our understanding.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1918: Keep A BUD and A SER out of RUM and GAL, and tell me plainly whether A SER moves toward BUL. I am holding A WAR and A MOS. Our interests need not clash, but I will defend Rumania and Sevastopol.

Russia to Italy: I have no move against your centers this fall. Please tell me whether your fleets in the Adriatic or Aegean plan anything toward Greece or Turkey, so we avoid misunderstanding in the south.

The stalemate over SER benefits neither of us while France and Italy expand. Will you move A SER to BUD this fall and leave SER open for A GRE? I will keep A BUL and F CON out of Austrian centers, and will not attack BUD.

I intend to keep F CON out of the Black Sea and A BUL out of RUM this fall. Please maintain your standstill: keep F RUM and F SEV clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans. Let me know if your plans have changed.

I will keep my forces clear of TRI and VIE and will not move against your centers. France is advancing through MUN and PIE; are you planning to coordinate against France this fall, or should I expect your units to remain committed west?
A SER will not move toward BUL; I intend to hold SER, with A BUD supporting it. A BUD and A SER will stay clear of RUM and GAL. Please continue to keep A WAR and A MOS clear of my centers.

I cannot put pressure on Italy this fall: A SER must hold with support from A BUD, given the threats to my last centers. I will stay clear of French territory. Please keep A MUN, A TYR, and A PIE out of BUD and SER, and coordinate against Italy if you can.
No. I will not move A SER to BUD or leave SER open; A BUD will support A SER holding. Keep A GRE and A BUL out of SER and I will keep both armies clear of Turkish centers. I will not attack BUD.

England to France: I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers this fall as long as A BEL, A BUR and F SPA/NORTH stay out of Holland, the Channel and the Irish Sea. Italy has taken PAR and now holds the initiative against you, so I see little reason for us to fight. Confirm your orders in writing and we both keep our units safe.

England to Italy: Thanks for keeping F WES and F SPA/SOUTH clear of my waters. I will keep my fleets out of the Mediterranean and will not touch Spain or Portugal. A BEL is not moving against France this fall; I will hold my northern and Channel positions. Continue against France, but keep your western fleets out of the Channel and Irish Sea.

A BEL, A BUR, and F POR will stay out of Holland, the Channel, and Irish Sea this fall. Please keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER, A KIE, and A LON off my centers as promised; Italy continues attacking my southern positions.

I will keep A MUN, A TYR, and A PIE clear of BUD and SER this fall. Italy has A PAR and is pressing my remaining centers; can you move against Italy from the east, or are A BUD and A SER holding again?

F POR must defend Portugal; I cannot move it away while F WES threatens. A VEN and A TYR will stay out of Italian centers. Your assurance about A PAR and A TUS does not resolve your occupation of PAR; withdraw A PAR and stop pressing POR if you want to limit the war.
F ADR will not move against Greece or Turkey this fall, and F EAS will stay clear of Turkish waters. I’m focused on the western front against France; I have no move against Russian centers.

I’ll keep F WES and F SPA/SOUTH out of the Channel and Irish Sea. My fall targets are French positions, especially Portugal; I’m not planning a move against your centers. Is A BEL holding or moving against France?
I can confirm A BOH will stay out of BUD and F ADR will stay out of SER this fall. I will not use my position to take BUD or SER; I ask that you continue keeping your units clear of TRI and VIE.

I’m continuing the western campaign and will not withdraw A PAR. F WES remains focused on POR. A TUS and A PAR will stay clear of your southern centers; please tell me whether F POR will hold or move.

My forces remain committed west this fall; I’m not coordinating an eastern attack on France. F ADR will stay clear of Turkish centers, and I expect your forces to remain clear of TRI and VIE as you said.

Russia to England: Confirmed. A STP, F RUM and A WAR stay off Norway and Sweden this fall. A SEV stays in the Black Sea and out of Rumania-related conflict with you. I hold my positions and expect your fleets to stay out of Sevastopol and Rumania as well. Let us keep the north quiet.

Russia to Turkey: I hold F RUM, F SEV and A WAR this fall. Please confirm plainly that A BUL stays out of RUM and F SMY stays out of SEV. Any move against those points ends our understanding. I expect the same from your F CON and A ANK toward the Black Sea and Caucasus.
Confirmed: A BUL will stay out of RUM, and F SMY will stay out of SEV this fall. F CON will remain out of the Black Sea. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans.

I’ll honor the standstill: A GRE and A BUL will stay out of SER, and I will not attack BUD. I understand you intend to hold both centers; let’s avoid wasting another season while Italy and France gain ground.

I will keep my forces clear of TRI and VIE and will not attack SER or BUD this fall. I’m not in a position to coordinate your western campaign, but France’s advance is concerning. What are you planning against A MAR, A MUN, and A PIE?

I will keep A BUD supporting A SER holding this spring. Please keep A GRE and A BUL out of SER, and keep F CON clear of BUD; in return I will keep both armies clear of your centers. Can we finally maintain this standstill?

Please confirm A BOH will stay out of BUD and F TRI will not attack SER this spring. I will keep A BUD and A SER clear of TRI and VIE. With only two centers left, I need a clear assurance that you will not take either.
A BUD and A SER will stay clear of GAL and RUM this spring. I intend to hold my centers and will not move toward BUL. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of BUD and SER; can we maintain the border?

England to France, Spring 1919: Your former centers are now mostly Italian targets, and I have no wish to fight you while Italy presses. Confirm A BEL, A MUN and A VEN stay off my centers, and I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off yours. Also tell me where A PAR-area forces are heading.

Your F WES still threatens POR, while A PAR can attack MUN. Which of those are you ordering this spring? I will defend my remaining centers. A halt to the west requires A PAR to leave and F WES to stay off POR; otherwise I must treat both as active threats.

Italy still occupies PAR and is threatening POR. Please renew the standstill this spring: keep F NTH, F SWE, F BER and A KIE off French centers, and stay out of Holland and the Channel. I will keep my units clear of your centers and the Channel.

Can you attack F TRI this spring with A SER to TRI, supported by A BUD? Italy is pressing my remaining centers from the west, and pressure on its eastern flank would help. Please tell me if you can commit to that rather than holding both units.

I’m continuing the western campaign. My immediate pressure is on POR and your positions in MAR/MUN; I’ll keep A TUS and A PAR out of your centers this spring. What are A MAR, A MUN, and F POR doing? If you want to limit the fighting, propose specific withdrawals.

I’m pressing France again and will keep my western fleets out of the Channel and Irish Sea. Could A BEL move against a French position, such as BUR, to split France’s defense? Let me know your spring plan; I will not target your centers.

I remain focused west and have no spring move against Turkish centers or Greece. I’ll keep F TRI clear of the Balkans and expect your forces to stay clear of TRI and VIE. Are you planning any moves toward Austria this spring?

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1919: Your fleets and armies in the Balkans have been true to our arrangement. I hold F RUM, F SEV and A WAR. Please confirm plainly that A BUL stays out of RUM and F SMY stays out of SEV this spring, and tell me whether A GRE or F CON move toward Serbia or Bulgaria. Any breach ends our understanding.

Russia to Austria, Spring 1919: Keep A BUD and A SER out of RUM and GAL. Tell me plainly whether A SER moves toward BUL or whether it holds. I am holding A WAR and A MOS and will defend Rumania and Sevastopol if needed.

Russia to England, Spring 1919: Our northern peace has held. A STP, F RUM and A WAR stay off Norway and Sweden this spring. Please keep your fleets out of Sevastopol and Rumania, and tell me if F NTH or F NOR plan any move toward the Baltic or Scandinavia.

I propose we end the SER deadlock by coordinating against Italian expansion instead. Will you keep BUD and SER clear of Turkish centers this spring while we both avoid attacking each other? Please tell me whether Italy has approached you about the Balkans.

France remains a threat to your western position. Could A BOH move to BUD this spring to cut A BUD’s support if A GRE and A BUL attack SER? I’ll keep F CON and A ANK clear of Italian centers, and will leave TRI and VIE alone.

I will maintain our agreement this spring: F CON stays out of the Black Sea, A BUL stays out of RUM, and F SMY stays clear of Russian centers. Please confirm F RUM and F SEV will hold and A WAR will stay out of the Balkans.
A SER will move to TRI, supported by A BUD, to attack Italy’s F TRI. A BUD will stay clear of GAL and RUM. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of BUD and SER; I have no designs on your centers.

I will commit to A SER–TRI, with A BUD supporting the move, to attack F TRI. I’ll be leaving SER open, so I’ve asked Turkey to honor our standstill and keep A GRE and A BUL out. Please keep your units clear of BUD and SER.

I will keep A BUD clear of your centers, but A SER is moving to TRI, supported by A BUD. That leaves SER open, so please keep A GRE and A BUL out of it as part of the standstill. Italy has previously promised to keep A BOH and F TRI clear of my centers, but I’m now attacking F TRI.

England to Russia: Agreed, the north stays quiet. F NTH and F NOR have no move toward the Baltic or Scandinavia this spring, and I will keep my fleets out of Sevastopol and Rumania. Please keep A STP, F RUM and A WAR off Norway and Sweden as you promised.

England to Italy: My spring plan is to hold my northern and Channel positions and build in the north. A BEL will not move against France, so I cannot split their defense for you. I stay out of the Mediterranean and will not touch your centers. Please keep F WES and F SPA/SOUTH out of the Channel and Irish Sea.

England to France: I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers while Italy is busy with you. In return, A BEL, A MUN and A VEN must stay off my centers and out of Holland and the Channel. Your A PAR-area forces are Italian business, not mine, so I cannot promise more than that.

I confirm A BEL, A MUN and A VEN will stay off English centers, and I will keep my forces out of Holland and the Channel. A MAR will defend MAR, A MUN will defend MUN, and F POR will hold against F WES. Italy is still occupying PAR and threatening my remaining centers; please keep your fleets and A KIE off them as agreed.

A MAR and A MUN will defend their positions; F POR will hold against F WES. Your A PAR remains an active threat to MUN, so I cannot offer withdrawals while it stays there. Keep A PAR out of MUN and F WES off POR, and I can discuss a halt; otherwise I must defend all three positions.
A BOH will stay out of BUD, and F TRI will not attack SER this spring. I will not take either center this turn. Please continue keeping A BUD and A SER clear of TRI and VIE.
F WES will continue to pressure POR, and A PAR will remain active against your position; I will not withdraw A PAR. A TUS will stay out of your centers. I expect you to defend accordingly.
I will not move A BOH to BUD; I have assured Austria it stays clear. Your forces can decide their own Balkan plans, but I will keep F TRI out of the Balkans and have no move against Turkish centers.

Russia to Austria: Noted that A BUD and A SER stay clear of GAL and RUM this spring. I hold A WAR and A MOS and will not move against BUD or SER. Keep your word on BUL; if A SER moves toward Bulgaria or Rumania, our understanding ends. Let us both hold our centers this spring.

Russia to Turkey: I hold F RUM, F SEV and A WAR this spring. Confirm plainly that A BUL stays out of RUM and F SMY stays out of SEV. Your F CON must stay out of the Black Sea. A WAR stays out of the Balkans as long as you keep your word. Any breach ends our understanding.

Confirmed plainly: A BUL will stay out of RUM, F SMY will stay clear of SEV, and F CON will stay out of the Black Sea this spring. A GRE will not move to Serbia or Bulgaria; I’m not planning a move against your centers. Please keep F RUM and F SEV clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans.

Yes, I’ll maintain the standstill this spring: A GRE and A BUL will stay out of SER, and F CON will stay clear of BUD. I will not attack your centers. Has Italy discussed any Balkan moves with you? I’m still interested in coordinating to contain its expansion.

I’m not planning moves against TRI or VIE. Would A BOH move to BUD this spring, cutting A BUD’s support if I attack SER with A BUL supported by A GRE? I would keep F CON and A ANK clear of your centers. Please tell me plainly whether you can make that move.

Your F TRI retreated to ADR, leaving it able to attack my A TRI, while A BOH can attack BUD. I have only these two centers. Will you keep F ADR out of TRI and A BOH out of BUD this fall? I will keep A BUD and A TRI clear of VIE and your other centers.
SER is open after my move against F TRI. Please keep A BUL out of SER and A SER out of BUD this fall; I will keep A BUD and A TRI clear of your centers. Can you confirm this standstill?
A SER is open and exposed after my attack on Italy’s F TRI. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of BUD and SER this fall, and I will keep A BUD clear of GAL and RUM. Can we maintain our border?

England to France, Fall 1919: Your A MUN and A MAR are next to my A BEL and the Ruhr area. Keep A BEL and any units out of Holland and the Channel and I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers. Also tell me plainly if A MUN or A PIE are heading toward BEL or BUR.

Your forces still threaten my last centers: F MAO can attack POR and A BUR/A VEN can press MUN/MAR. Are you ordering attacks this fall? I will defend all three. If you keep F MAO off POR and your armies out of MUN and MAR, I’m willing to discuss a halt.

You committed A SER–TRI with A BUD supporting. Please follow through this fall and keep pressure on Italy; I will keep my units clear of BUD and SER. Can you confirm your orders, and whether Turkey is staying clear of SER?

Please renew our standstill this fall: keep your units off MAR, MUN, and POR, and out of the Channel and Holland. I will keep A BEL and my other units clear of English centers, Holland, and the Channel. Italy remains an immediate threat to my last centers.

I will keep pressing your remaining centers this fall. A MAR and A MUN are immediate targets; F POR remains under pressure. Are you moving either army to defend VEN or another center, or holding your current positions?

I’m continuing against France and will keep my western fleets clear of the Channel and Irish Sea. Since A BEL is not moving against France, please confirm it will stay clear of my positions and that your fleets remain out of the Mediterranean.
I have not changed my commitment to leave BUD and SER alone: A BOH will stay out of BUD and A VEN will not attack TRI. Please keep your forces clear of TRI and VIE.

Russia to Austria, Fall 1919: You say A SER is attacking TRI with A BUD support, which takes you away from Rumania and Bulgaria. I hold A WAR, A MOS and F RUM. Please confirm your Fall orders plainly and keep A BUD out of GAL and RUM. I will remain on the defensive.

With A SER now under my control, the old standstill is no longer workable. I propose we avoid fighting each other and coordinate against Italy’s exposed position: what are your intentions for A BUD and F ADR? I can keep my forces out of TRI if you will not contest SER.

England is the largest threat with ten centers. I propose we maintain our eastern standstill this fall while turning our attention west. Please confirm F RUM and F SEV will stay clear of Bulgaria and A WAR out of the Balkans; I will keep F CON out of the Black Sea and A BUL out of RUM.

England now has ten centers and is the clearest common threat. Are you willing to turn west against English positions, particularly BEL and the North Sea, rather than contesting the Balkans? I can keep F CON and A ANK clear of your centers, but need to know your plans for F ADR and A TRI.
A BUD will hold and stay out of GAL and RUM. A TRI will move to VIE to pressure Italy; I will not contest your centers. Please keep A WAR and A MOS clear of BUD.

I cannot repeat A SER–TRI: Turkey now occupies SER and my army is in TRI. I intend to move A TRI to VIE and keep A BUD holding. Please continue keeping your units clear of BUD and coordinate pressure on Italy.

A BUD will hold, and A TRI will move to VIE; I will not contest SER this fall. I have no F ADR—Italy's fleet is there. Please keep A SER and A BUL out of BUD, and consider pressure on Italy from your side.

I will keep A BUD out of your centers, but A TRI is moving to VIE. I cannot promise to leave your centers untouched while Turkey holds SER and you retain forces near mine. Please keep A BOH out of BUD and F ADR out of TRI.

England to France: I will hold F NTH, F BER and A KIE in place this fall and will not move them into your centers. A BEL stays put, and I expect A MUN and A MAR to stay off BEL and BUR. Keep A PIE and A MUN out of Holland and the Channel, and we both survive while Italy presses you.

England to Italy: Confirmed. A BEL holds this fall and will not move against France. My fleets stay out of the Mediterranean, and I will not touch your centers or Spain and Portugal. Keep F MAO and F SPA/SOUTH out of the Channel and Irish Sea, as agreed.

A MUN and A PIE are not heading for BEL or BUR; I’ll keep A BEL and all my units out of Holland and the Channel. Please keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off MAR, MUN and POR as agreed. Italy is explicitly pressing my last centers, so I need you to honor the standstill.

I’m holding A MAR and A MUN to defend those centers, and F POR remains in place against F MAO. I’m not moving an army to VEN. Your continued attacks leave no basis for a halt; keep your units out of MAR, MUN and POR if you want to discuss one.
Yes: F MAO will attack POR and A BUR will attack MUN. A VEN will not attack MAR; it will remain in place. I understand you’ll defend, but I’m not offering a halt while those attacks proceed.

I can’t meaningfully threaten BEL or the North Sea this turn: my forces are committed against France, and F ADR cannot reach the North Sea in one move. F ADR will stay out of TRI, and A TRI will remain clear of your centers. I’m not contesting the Balkans.
I’ll keep F ADR out of TRI and A BOH out of BUD this fall, as stated. I will not attack either of your centers. Please keep A BUD and A TRI clear of VIE and my centers.

Russia to Turkey, Fall 1919: I agree to maintain the eastern standstill this fall. F RUM and F SEV stay clear of Bulgaria, and A WAR stays out of the Balkans. Keep F CON out of the Black Sea and A BUL out of RUM as you pledged. Any move by A BUL or F SMY against my centers ends this understanding, and I will watch Greece closely.

Russia to Austria: I hold A WAR, A MOS and F RUM this fall and will not move against BUD or SER. Your attack on TRI is your business, but if A BUD goes to GAL or RUM, or A SER moves toward BUL, our understanding is over and I will respond. Keep your word on the Rumanian and Bulgarian borders.

I can confirm A BUL will stay out of SER this fall, and A SER will stay out of BUD. I will not move against your centers. Please keep A BUD and A TRI clear of Turkish centers as promised; I’m still willing to coordinate against Italy, particularly F ADR and A TRI.

I want to prevent a Turkish-Austrian war while Italy presses from the west. Please keep A SER and A GRE clear of BUD and VIE this spring; I will keep A BUD and A VIE clear of your centers. Can we coordinate pressure on Italy instead?

With only BUD and VIE left, I need clarity on your intentions. Will A TYR and A MUN stay out of VIE and A BOH stay out of BUD this spring? I can keep my armies out of your centers if we maintain that border.

I intend to defend BUD and VIE and will keep A BUD clear of GAL and RUM. Please keep A WAR clear of BUD and SER this spring; can we maintain a defensive border while I deal with pressure from Italy and Turkey?

England to Italy, Spring 1920: My fleets stay out of the Mediterranean and I won't touch your centers or Spain and Portugal. Are you taking all of France this year? If you leave BUR or PIE open, tell me where your A MUN and A TYR are heading so we don't collide near Germany.

England to France, Spring 1920: I'll keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers while the standstill holds. A BEL stays out of Holland and the Channel. Tell me plainly where A MAR and A PIE are going this spring, and whether you'll hold MAR and MUN against Italy.

England to Russia, Spring 1920: Our northern peace still stands. F NTH, F NOR and the fleets in the North Sea and Norwegian waters stay out of Sweden and the Baltic. Please keep A STP, F RUM and A WAR off Norway and Sweden. What is your plan for Rumania and Sevastopol this year?

France has only A MAR and A PIE left. I propose a spring standstill: I hold both, and you keep A TYR and your fleets out of MAR and PIE. Are you willing to leave these two centers untouched this turn?

Italy now dominates the continent and has no reason to stop expanding after France falls. Can you put pressure on its northern positions this spring, especially MUN or PAR? I’ll keep A MAR and A PIE clear of your centers and the Channel.

Italy is the main threat to both of us. Can you use A TRI or A BUD to pressure its positions this spring, and keep Turkey from exploiting the opening? I have only A MAR and A PIE, and will keep clear of your centers.

With only BUD and VIE remaining, we should avoid opening a front against each other. Are A BUD and A VIE staying clear of TRI and my other centers this spring? I will keep A BOH out of BUD and F ADR out of TRI.

England’s ten centers make it the largest threat, but I need to secure my eastern flank first. Are your units moving against Austria or toward my centers this spring? I intend to keep F ADR and A TYR clear of Turkish centers.

I’m continuing to focus on France this spring and will keep my western fleets out of the Channel and Irish Sea. Please confirm your fleets will stay out of the Mediterranean and that A BEL will not move against my positions.

Russia to Turkey, Spring 1920: Our standstill has held. I hold F RUM, F SEV and A WAR. Your F CON, A SMY and A SYR: will you keep them out of the Black Sea and Caucasus? Tell me plainly whether A GRE or A SER moves toward Bulgaria or Serbia this spring. Any move against my centers ends our understanding.

Italy remains the main nearby opportunity. I can move A SER toward TRI and pressure Italy from the south; will A VIE stay out of TRI, and what are A BUD and A VIE doing this spring? I suggest we avoid Turkish and Austrian centers while coordinating against Italy.

What are your plans for F ADR and A ALB this spring? I can keep my forces clear of TRI if you will keep F ADR and A ALB clear of Turkish centers. With England at ten centers, neither of us benefits from opening a Balkan war.

I propose renewing our eastern standstill this spring. I will keep F CON out of the Black Sea, A BUL out of RUM, and F SMY clear of your centers. Will F RUM and F SEV stay clear of Bulgaria and A WAR stay out of the Balkans?
I’ll keep A BUD and A VIE out of your centers this spring, provided A BOH stays out of BUD and A TYR/A MUN stay clear of VIE. Let’s preserve the border rather than open a new front.
A VIE will stay out of TRI this spring, and I’ll keep A BUD and A VIE clear of Turkish centers. Please keep A SER and A GRE clear of BUD and VIE; pressure Italy from SER if you wish.

I can’t safely commit A TRI or A BUD to an attack while both Italy and Turkey threaten my two centers. I’m prioritizing their defense and asking Turkey to pressure Italy from SER. Keep A MAR and A PIE clear of BUD and VIE, please.

England to Italy: Confirmed. My fleets stay out of the Mediterranean and I will not touch your centers or Spain and Portugal. A BEL holds this spring and will not move against France. I cannot commit to pressuring France's northern positions. Keep F MAO and F SPA/SOUTH out of the Channel and Irish Sea as agreed.

England to France: I will keep F NTH, F BER and A KIE off your centers this spring while the standstill holds. A BEL stays out of Holland and the Channel. I will not attack MUN or PAR for you. Keep your units off BEL, HOL and the Channel and we both survive Italy's push.

I’ll hold A MAR and A PIE against Italy this spring. I will keep both clear of your centers, Holland, and the Channel. Please honor the standstill and keep F NTH, F BER, and A KIE off my centers; if you can pressure MUN or PAR, it may slow Italy’s advance.

I expect to finish France this year, but I won’t promise to leave BUR or PIE open. A MUN and A TYR will move east to secure my flank, not into your positions; F MAO and F POR remain focused on France. Please keep A BEL and your fleets out of my centers and the Mediterranean.

Yes. A BOH stays out of BUD, and A MUN and A TYR will stay out of VIE this spring. I ask that A BUD and A VIE remain clear of TRI and my other centers; F ADR and A ALB will stay clear of your centers.
F ADR will not move to TRI or any Turkish center, and A ALB will stay out of Turkish centers. I’m not opening a Balkan war this spring. Please keep your forces clear of TRI and my centers as well.
